Title: 1. Top Gun
description: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman.

Title: 2. Crocodile Dundee
description: An American reporter travels to the Australian outback to meet eccentric poacher Mick "Crocodile" Dundee and invites him to New York City, where he comes face-to-face with the complexities of modern life.

Title: 3. Platoon
description: Chris Taylor, a naive American, volunteers for Vietnam combat. He feels insignificant among experienced soldiers. Two sergeants, harsh Barnes and cooperative Elias, clash over an illegal killing during a raid. Chris faces meltdown.

Title: 4. The Karate Kid Part II
description: Daniel accompanies his mentor, Mr. Miyagi, to Miyagi's childhood home in Okinawa. Miyagi visits his dying father and confronts his old rival, while Daniel falls in love and inadvertently makes a new rival of his own.

Title: 5. Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
description: To save Earth from an alien probe, Admiral James T. Kirk and his fugitive crew go back in time to San Francisco in 1986 to retrieve the only beings who can communicate with it: humpback whales.

Title: 6. Back to School
description: To encourage his uninspired son to get through college, a wealthy and fun loving, but somewhat obnoxious, businessman decides to enter the school as a student himself.

Title: 7. Aliens
description: Decades after surviving the Nostromo incident, Ellen Ripley is sent out to re-establish contact with a terraforming colony but finds herself battling the Alien Queen and her offspring.

Title: 8. The Golden Child
description: A private detective specializing in missing children is charged with the task of finding a special child whom dark forces want to eliminate.

Title: 9. Ruthless People
description: A couple cheated by a vile businessman kidnaps his wife in retaliation, not knowing that their enemy is delighted that they did.

Title: 10. Ferris Bueller's Day Off
description: A brash, cocky high school senior, tired of skipping school to spend a boring day at home, is determined to enjoy an epic day roaring around his favorite Chicago sites, enlisting his best friend and girlfriend to join him on the adventure.

Title: 11. Down and Out in Beverly Hills
description: A rich but troubled family find their lives altered by the arrival of a vagrant who tries to drown himself in their swimming pool.

Title: 12. Stand by Me
description: A writer recounts a childhood journey with his friends to view the body of a boy who went missing in the woods.

Title: 13. The Color of Money
description: Fast Eddie Felson teaches a cocky but immensely talented protégé the ropes of pool hustling, which in turn inspires him to make an unlikely comeback.

Title: 14. Legal Eagles
description: A New York district attorney works and flirts with his adversary and her kooky artist client, who is on trial for a murder she didn't commit.

Title: 15. Cobra
description: A tough-on-crime street cop must protect the only surviving witness to a strange murderous cult with far-reaching plans.

Title: 16. An American Tail
description: While emigrating to the United States, a young Russian mouse gets separated from his family and must locate them while trying to survive in a new country.

Title: 17. Police Academy 3: Back in Training
description: After it's announced that one of the two police academies in the state will be closed down, Lassard's alumni return to the school to train new recruits and compete against the other academy.

Title: 18. Heartbreak Ridge
description: Hard-nosed, hard-living Marine Gunnery Sergeant Tom Highway clashes with his superiors and his ex-wife as he takes command of a spoiled recon platoon with a bad attitude.

Title: 19. Peggy Sue Got Married
description: Peggy Sue, on the verge of a divorce, faints at her 25th high school reunion, and wakes up to find herself back in 1960, leading her to try to spot and correct the mistakes that led to disappointments and an unhappy marriage.

Title: 20. Poltergeist II: The Other Side
description: The Freeling family have a new house, but their troubles with supernatural forces don't seem to be over.

Title: 21. Short Circuit
description: Number 5 of a group of experimental robots in a lab is electrocuted, suddenly becomes intelligent, and escapes.

Title: 22. Pretty in Pink
description: A poor girl must choose between the affections of dating her childhood sweetheart or a rich but sensitive playboy.

Title: 23. The Fly
description: A botched experiment transmutes a man into a monstrous insect.

Title: 24. Hannah and Her Sisters
description: Between three Thanksgivings two years apart, Hannah's husband falls in love with her sister Lee, while her hypochondriac ex-husband rekindles his relationship with her sister Holly.

Title: 25. ¡Three Amigos!
description: Three actors accept an invitation to a Mexican village to perform their onscreen bandit fighter roles, unaware that it is the real thing.

Title: 26. Little Shop of Horrors
description: A nerdy florist finds his chance for success and romance with the help of a giant man-eating plant who demands to be fed.

Title: 27. About Last Night
description: Chicago singles meet in a bar, live together and call it love. Based on David Mamet's play Sexual Perversity in Chicago.

Title: 28. The Great Mouse Detective
description: Basil, the rodent Sherlock Holmes, investigates the kidnapping of a toy maker and uncovers its link to his archenemy, Professor Ratigan.

Title: 29. Running Scared
description: Two street-wise Chicago cops have to shake off some rust after returning from a Key West vacation to pursue a drug dealer who nearly killed them in the past.

Title: 30. The Money Pit
description: A young couple struggles to repair a hopelessly dilapidated house.

Title: 31. Gung Ho
description: When a Japanese automobile company buys an American plant, the American liaison must mediate the clash of work attitudes between the foreign management and native labor.

Title: 32. Nothing in Common
description: A successful advertising executive finds his freewheeling life crashing to a halt when his parents end their longtime marriage.

Title: 33. Children of a Lesser God
description: A new speech teacher at a school for the deaf falls in love with the janitor, a deaf woman speechless by choice.

Title: 34. Jumpin' Jack Flash
description: An American computer whiz who works at a New York bank is suddenly thrust into the world of international espionage after she inadvertently receives a coded message from a British spy.

Title: 35. Hoosiers
description: A coach with a checkered past and a local drunk train a small-town high school basketball team to become a top contender for the state championship in 1950s Indiana.

Title: 36. Soul Man
description: To achieve his dream of attending Harvard, a pampered teen poses as a young black man to receive a full scholarship.

Title: 37. Wildcats
description: Rookie high school football coach Molly McGrath has a harder time than she expected trying to whip her tough inner-city team members into shape.

Title: 38. Heartburn
description: She's a magazine writer who gives up her career for love and family. He's a playboy newspaper columnist who can't quite give up his old tricks. And if that combination doesn't give a relationship Heartburn, nothing will.

Title: 39. The Morning After
description: A washed-up, alcoholic actress who is prone to blackouts wakes up next to a murdered man. Did she kill him and, if not, is she in danger?

Title: 40. Iron Eagle
description: A young pilot plans a rescue mission when his father, an Air Force Colonel, is shot down over enemy territory and captured.

Title: 41. Crimes of the Heart
description: Three southern sisters try to come to grips with the meaning of their mother's suicide.

Title: 42. Tough Guys
description: Two elderly gangsters are released from prison only to find they have trouble fitting in as old men who still take no guff from anyone.

Title: 43. A Room with a View
description: Lucy Honeychurch shares a brief romance with George Emerson in Florence. Yet as she tries to move on with her life and look for marriage elsewhere, can she truly forget the events of that summer?

Title: 44. F/X
description: A special effects wizard is hired by federal agents to fake a mobster's assassination, only to realize he has been set up as a scapegoat, forcing him to use his cinematic illusions to survive a lethal game of cat and mouse.

Title: 45. Friday the 13th Part VI: Jason Lives
description: Tommy Jarvis exhumes Jason Voorhees to cremate his corpse, but inadvertently brings him back to life instead. The newly revived killer seeks revenge, and Tommy may be the only one who can stop him.

Title: 46. Flight of the Navigator
description: In 1978, a boy travels eight years into the future and has an adventure with an intelligent, wisecracking alien ship.

Title: 47. Jo Jo Dancer, Your Life Is Calling
description: After severely burning himself in a drug incident, a comedian has a near death experience in which he reviews his life.

Title: 48. The Delta Force
description: After a plane is hijacked by terrorists, The Delta Force is sent in to resolve the crisis.

Title: 49. The Big Easy
description: A New Orleans Detective Lieutenant and an Assistant District Attorney investigate police corruption and gangland murders.

Title: 50. The Mission
description: Eighteenth-century Spanish Jesuits try to protect a remote South American tribe in danger of falling under the rule of pro-slavery Portugal.

Title: 51. Howard the Duck
description: A sarcastic humanoid duck is pulled from his homeworld to Earth where he must stop an alien invasion with the help of a nerdy scientist and a struggling female rock singer.

Title: 52. Raw Deal
description: A former FBI agent turned small-town sheriff agrees to help the FBI chief infiltrate the Chicago mafia when the FBI chief's son is killed by them.

Title: 53. Armed and Dangerous
description: A fired cop and useless lawyer sign up as security guards and find they've joined a corrupt union.

Title: 54. Youngblood
description: A 17 year-old farm boy is offered an ice hockey tryout up in Canada. He has fast legs, slow fists, but is chosen. Will he learn to use his fists and play ice hockey the Canuck way? Will he get the coach's cute daughter?

Title: 55. Psycho III
description: Norman Bates falls in love with a fallen nun who stays at the Bates Motel alongside a drifter and a curious reporter. Meanwhile, "Mother" is still watching.

Title: 56. The Mosquito Coast
description: An inventor spurns his city life and moves his family into the jungles of Central America to make a utopia.

Title: 57. Sweet Liberty
description: After selling the rights of his book to a movie production company, a writer finds himself fighting the many egos and varying views around him.

Title: 58. Labyrinth
description: Teenage Sarah journeys through a maze to save her baby brother from the Goblin King.

Title: 59. One Crazy Summer
description: An aspiring teenage cartoonist and his friends come to the aid of a singer trying to save her family property from developers.

Title: 60. Extremities
description: A woman narrowly escapes assault but loses her purse. Fearing retaliation, she seeks help. When her attacker returns, she manages to trap him. Now she faces a moral quandary: free him, report him, or take matters into her own hands.

Title: 61. The Adventures of Milo and Otis
description: The adventures of a young cat and a dog as they find themselves accidentally separated and each swept into a hazardous trek.

Title: 62. Critters
description: A group of small but vicious alien creatures called Crites escape from an alien prison transport vessel and land near a small farm town on earth, pursued by two shape-shifting bounty hunters.

Title: 63. April Fool's Day
description: Nine college students staying at a friend's remote island mansion begin to fall victim to an unseen murderer over the April Fool's Day weekend, but nothing is as it seems.

Title: 64. Club Paradise
description: A retired Chicago firefighter partners with a reggae singer to turn a seedy Caribbean nightclub into a resort for affluent tourists.

Title: 65. No Mercy
description: A Chicago detective, seeking to avenge his partner's death, travels to New Orleans where he unexpectedly becomes involved in a cat and mouse game of survival.

Title: 66. Brighton Beach Memoirs
description: Eugene, a young teenage Jewish boy, recalls his memoirs of his time as an adolescent youth. He goes through the hardships of puberty, sexual fantasy, and living the life of a poor boy in a crowded house.

Title: 67. Firewalker
description: A pair of adventurers try to track down an ancient Aztec/Mayan/Egyptian/Apache hoard of gold.

Title: 68. Big Trouble in Little China
description: A truck driver is pulled into Chinatown conflict when a sorcerer kidnaps a friend's fiancée, forcing them into a hidden war of gangs, magic, and prophecy beneath San Francisco.

Title: 69. Under the Cherry Moon
description: Two con artist brothers attempt to swindle a soon-to-be wealthy heiress, but things get complicated when one falls in love with her.

Title: 70. The Transformers: The Movie
description: The Autobots must stop a colossal planet-consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.

Title: 71. Murphy's Law
description: Framed for his ex-wife's murder by a parolee he once put behind bars, Los Angeles cop Jack Murphy escapes from custody to capture the killer, but he is now handcuffed to a foul-mouthed thief he had only just arrested.

Title: 72. SpaceCamp
description: The young attendees of a space camp find themselves in space for real when their shuttle is accidentally launched into orbit.

Title: 73. Deadly Friend
description: After his friend is killed by her abusive father, the new kid in town attempts to save her by implanting a robotic microchip into her brain.

Title: 74. Manhunter
description: Former FBI profiler Will Graham returns to service to pursue a deranged serial killer dubbed "the Tooth Fairy" by the media.

Title: 75. Blue Velvet
description: A young man finds a severed human ear that is somehow connected to a mysterious lounge singer and a group of psychopathic criminals who have kidnapped her child.

Title: 76. Care Bears Movie II: A New Generation
description: The Care Bears try to help a young girl at summer camp who, in an effort to revamp her dorky social status to agility and skill, enters into a sinister bargain with a shape-shifting demon posing as a young boy.

Title: 77. Wise Guys
description: Harry Valentini and Moe Dickstein are both errand boys for the Mob. When they lose two hundred fifty thousand dollars, they are set up to kill each other. But they run off to Atlantic City, and comedy follows.

Title: 78. Something Wild
description: A free-spirited woman "kidnaps" a yuppie for a weekend of adventure. But the fun quickly takes a dangerous turn when her ex-convict husband shows up.

Title: 79. Lucas
description: A socially inept fourteen-year-old experiences heartbreak for the first time when his two best friends - Cappie, an older-brother figure, and Maggie, the new girl with whom he is in love - fall for each other.

Title: 80. Haunted Honeymoon
description: Two radio voice actors are getting married. Larry has fits of fear. A shrink needs 36 hours to scare him to death and cure him - during a family reunion at a scary family castle.

Title: 81. The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
description: A radio host is victimized by the cannibal family as a former Texas marshal hunts them.

Title: 82. The Best of Times
description: A small-town loser determines to have one more shot at the big time by winning a football game.

Title: 83. Quicksilver
description: Failed stock market whiz kid Jack Casey gets a job on a bike at San Francisco's Quicksilver Speed Delivery, where he befriends entrepreneur Hector Rodriguez and attractive fellow bicycler Terri, then finds an enemy in drug dealer Gypsy.

Title: 84. Wanted: Dead or Alive
description: A bounty hunter is offered $250,000 by CIA to get the terrorist behind an LA movie theater bombing. He quit CIA because he couldn't trust them. Can they be trusted now? Can he stop the terrorists?

Title: 85. Maximum Overdrive
description: A group of people try to survive when machines start to come alive and become homicidal.

Title: 86. Witchboard
description: When his girlfriend becomes dangerously obsessed with a ghost she contacted using a Ouija board, Jim reluctantly joins forces with her ex-his own estranged childhood best friend-to identify and exorcise the evil spirit.

Title: 87. The Boy Who Could Fly
description: An autistic boy who dreams of flying touches everyone he meets, including a new family who has moved in after their father dies.

Title: 88. The Name of the Rose
description: An intellectually nonconformist friar investigates a series of mysterious deaths in an isolated abbey.

Title: 89. She's Gotta Have It
description: Story of a woman and her three lovers.

Title: 90. Blue City
description: A drifter returns to his Florida hometown only to discover that his father, the local mayor, was mysteriously murdered during his absence. Vowing to find the killer and avenge his father's death, he starts his own investigation.

Title: 91. Trick or Treat
description: A bullied teenage boy is devastated after the death of his heavy metal idol, Sammi Curr. But as Halloween night approaches, he discovers that he may be the only one who can stop Sammi from making a Satanic comeback from beyond the grave.

Title: 92. 9½ Weeks
description: A New York art gallery curator starts a torrid love affair with a suave stranger who keeps pushing her boundaries.

Title: 93. Black Moon Rising
description: An FBI freelancer stashes a Las Vegas crime tape in a high-tech car.

Title: 94. Just Between Friends
description: Holly and Sandy strike up an instant friendship, not knowing that they actually have more in common than they'd like. Their relationship is tested when tragedy strikes.

Title: 95. A Fine Mess
description: An actor and a chef fathom a plot to fix a horse race and attempt at capitalizing it, while striving to tackle two of the hitmen responsible for the scheme.

Title: 96. My Little Pony: The Movie
description: Ponyland comes under attack from the Smooze, a massive purple ooze created by an evil witch who plans to destroy the ponies' annual spring festival.

Title: 97. Highlander
description: A 500 year old Scottish swordsman, currently residing in New York City, must confront the last of his immortal opponents, a murderously brutal barbarian who lusts for the fabled "Prize".

Title: 98. The Hitcher
description: A young man who escapes the clutches of a murderous hitchhiker is subsequently stalked by the hitcher and framed for his crimes.

Title: 99. Crossroads
description: A young guitar phenom seeking fame and fortune links up with a veteran blues player who he hopes can teach him a long-lost song by legendary Delta Blues virtuoso Robert Johnson.

Title: 100. Mona Lisa
description: A man recently released from prison manages to get a job driving a call girl from customer to customer.

Title: 101. Wisdom
description: Unable to find work after a past felony, graduate John Wisdom and his girlfriend embark on a cross-country bank-robbing spree in order to aid American farmers.

Title: 102. Troll
description: A wicked troll king in search of a mystical ring that will transform him to human form invades a San Francisco apartment complex where a powerful witch lives.

Title: 103. 52 Pick-Up
description: Successful Los Angeles construction magnate Harry Mitchell (Roy Scheider) has his life turned upside down when three hooded blackmailers come to him with a tape of Harry and his mistress, a stripper named Cini (Kelly Preston). They demand $105,000 per year for the tape. Because Harry's wife Barbara (Ann-Margret) is running for city council, he cannot go to the police. Harry decides not to pay, and the blackmailers respond by breaking into Harry's house and stealing his gun and some clothing. They use the stolen items to make another video, wherein they murder Cini with Harry's gun. Again they demand $105,000 per year. Harry tracks down the lead blackmailer, amateur adult filmmaker Alan Raimy (John Glover), and is able to convince Raimy he can only pay $52,000, which Raimy accepts. Harry then begins to turn the other blackmailers, psychotic Bobby (Clarence Williams III) and cowardly Leo (Robert Trebor), against each other and Raimy. This leads to Bobby attempting to break into Harry's house and kill him, but Harry and Barbara overpower him, and learn that Raimy did not mention the revised deal to his accomplices. As Leo begins to crack, Raimy and Bobby resort to further escalating violence, and Harry will have to fight to save himself and Barbara.

Title: 104. Out of Bounds
description: Daryl's parents ship him off to the big city to live with his brother, hoping he will have a better life there. After a baggage mix-up at the airport, Daryl finds himself in possession of a drug cache, which a drug dealer wants back.

Title: 105. Vamp
description: Two fraternity pledges travel to a sleazy bar in search of a stripper for their college friends, unaware it is occupied by vampires.

Title: 106. Jean de Florette
description: A greedy landowner and his backward nephew conspire to block the only water source for an adjoining property in order to bankrupt the owner and force him to sell.

Title: 107. Invaders from Mars
description: A boy tries to stop aliens who have taken over his town and are attempting to brainwash its inhabitants.

Title: 108. Band of the Hand
description: Five juvenile lost causes are sent to the Everglades where a war veteran tries to reform them using survival tactics. Their new skills and resolve are tested when a Miami drug lord targets them for trying to clean up their neighborhood.

Title: 109. American Anthem
description: Steve has given up on football and gymnastics after breaking an arm. Julie comes to town to train for the U.S. gymnastics championship, the first step to the Olympics. They meet and she motivates him to return to the gym.

Title: 110. Off Beat
description: Joe Gower's job is skating through library shelves, fetching books. A police officer and friend of his is chosen to participate in a charity dance performance. Gower agrees to take his place in the show by posing as a police officer. He falls for a female officer in the show, and gets into various scrapes with fellow cops and also crooks, and he dances.

Title: 111. My Chauffeur
description: A free-spirited young woman (Deborah Foreman) upsets the status quo at a stuffy Brentwood limousine service.

Title: 112. Violets Are Blue...
description: Young love may endure in your heart and one day re-ignite, but reality may soon dowse the flames.

Title: 113. King Kong Lives
description: Kong falls from the Twin Towers, and he appears to be alive, but his heart is failing, so it's replaced with an artificial one. All is well until he senses that there's a female Kong somewhere out there and escapes wreaking havoc.

Title: 114. Avenging Force
description: A senator is targeted by the Pentangle, a right wing paramilitary group. His pal, a former CIA agent and martial artist, tries to help him. The group kidnaps the agent's sister and tries to hunt him down, "The Most Dangerous Game" style.

Title: 115. No Retreat, No Surrender
description: Jason, a Bruce Lee fan, sees his karate instructor/dad beaten by martial art thugs. They move to Seattle where, after humiliations, he trains with Bruce Lee's ghost so he can defend himself and others against thugs.

Title: 116. Fire with Fire
description: A young woman from a Catholic school and a young man from a nearby prison camp fall in love and must run away together to escape the law, the church and their parents.

Title: 117. Eliminators
description: A cyborg created from a pilot's body by time-travel scientists escapes destruction and flees to America after his creator orders him dismantled. Seeking vengeance for his murdered ally, he must find help to stop the doctor's sinister plans

Title: 118. River's Edge
description: A high school slacker commits a shocking act and proceeds to let his friends in on the secret. However, the friends' reaction is almost as ambiguous and perplexing as the crime itself.

Title: 119. That's Life!
description: Harvey, a wealthy yet depressed architect and his sympathetic wife strive to conquer their life issues in anticipation of his 60th birthday party.

Title: 120. Tai-Pan
description: Historical fiction set against the backdrop of Hong Kong in its early years of British rule.

Title: 121. Manon of the Spring
description: A reclusive shepherdess plots vengeance on the men whose greedy conspiracy to acquire her father's land caused his death years earlier.

Title: 122. The Manhattan Project
description: A high school prodigy builds an atomic bomb with stolen plutonium to win the 45th National Science Fair and expose a nuclear weapons lab posing as a nuclear medical research facility in Ithaca, NY.

Title: 123. Power
description: After a close friend drops out of politics, a political consultant helping to find a replacement finds a web of corruption and deceit as well.

Title: 124. Allan Quatermain and the Lost City of Gold
description: Allan Quatermain once again teams up with Jesse Huston where the discovery of a mysterious old gold piece sends Quatermain looking for his long-lost brother, missing in the wilds of Africa after seeking a lost white race.

Title: 125. The Wraith
description: When a ruthless gang terrorizes an Arizona town, a mysterious biker must systematically eliminate the crew before they claim a local waitress, leveraging an indestructible black car and supernatural vengeance.

Title: 126. Born American
description: A trio of vacationing American students cross the border from Finland to the USSR during the Cold War and are soon imprisoned after a skirmish with Soviet soldiers.

Title: 127. 'Round Midnight
description: A troubled, but talented musician flees the US to escape his problems, finding refuge and support in Paris.

Title: 128. The Naked Cage
description: A young woman wrongly convicted of a bank robbery is sent to a prison run by a corrupt warden. She struggles to survive the harsh prison life, where violent bullying, sexual assault and drug addiction run rampant.

Title: 129. Bullies
description: The Morris family moves from the city in an attempt to make a new life in a small resort town, only to be confronted by a sadistic rural clan, the Cullens.

Title: 130. Sid and Nancy
description: The relationship between Sid Vicious, bassist for British punk group Sex Pistols, and his girlfriend Nancy Spungen is portrayed.

Title: 131. Heat
description: Las Vegas is the backdrop for all the torrid action of heat, as Burt Reynolds plays the soft-hearted bodyguard who's out to protect his friends.

Title: 132. Deadtime Stories
description: "Deadtime Stories" is a 1986 horror anthology, where a babysitting uncle tells his nephew three horror stories about killer witches, Little Red Riding Hood and a werewolf, and "Goldi Lox" and the three bears.

Title: 133. Playing for Keeps
description: Danny, Spikes and Silk have just recently graduated from high school in New York. Danny finds a title deed for a huge house in a small town. He has a dream to turn it into a Rock n' Roll hotel. The townspeople though are not very welcome to the New Yorkers. With a little help from an aging stockbroker, a local girl, and the "stockholders" (friends from New York), they are able to help Danny pursue his dream.

Title: 134. Heathcliff: The Movie
description: In the end, Heathcliff close the old photo album and the three nephews throw him out of the house and they all play together.

Title: 135. The Men's Club
description: Men form a discussion group to share feelings about life and women. As their gathering gets wilder, a wife comes home. After being kicked out, they still want to continue the night.

Title: 136. Streets of Gold
description: Alek is an immigrant who has just moved to the U. S. He was banned from competing for the USSR Olympic boxing team because of his religion. Depressed and alcoholic, he finds happiness and redemption when he trains two fighters.

Title: 137. True Stories
description: A small but growing Texas town, filled with strange and musical characters, celebrates its sesquicentennial and converge on a local parade and talent show.

Title: 138. Reform School Girls
description: A new group of girls arrives at Pridemore Juvenile Facility, where the brutal warden plays favoritism with a few, and treats the rest like animals. But one girl is not taking this horrible treatment lying down.

Title: 139. P.O.W. the Escape
description: Col. Cooper leads a group of American P.O.W.s, battling their way to freedom as Saigon falls to the Viet Cong.

Title: 140. Dangerously Close
description: A rebel without a cause at an elite uptight High School discovers some of his classmates have formed an even more elite clique hell-bent on ridding the school of what they deem to be its undesirables because of ethnicity, politics, etc.

Title: 141. At Close Range
description: Reunited with his career criminal father, tough teen Brad thinks he's found his ticket to an exciting life of crime, only to find out he's wrong.

Title: 142. Shanghai Surprise
description: Shanghai, 1938: A missionary woman hires a fortune hunter to help her find 1100 lbs. opium lost, as wounded need the morphine. Adventure and romance follows.

Title: 143. Sky Bandits
description: Through a series of circumstances, a pair of Old West gunfighters end up as fighter pilots in World War I.

Title: 144. Nomads
description: A French anthropologist specializing in nomadic groups moves to Los Angeles with his wife, and starts following a group of sinister street punks who seem to live and move around in a black van. But they aren't what they seem.

Title: 145. Meatballs III: Summer Job
description: The ghost of a dead porn star comes to Earth to help a nerd with his sex life.

Title: 146. Betty Blue
description: A lackadaisical handyman and aspiring novelist tries to support his younger girlfriend as she slowly succumbs to madness.

Title: 147. Rad
description: The story of one young man, Cru Jones, who has the intensity and desire to win a BMX race called Helltrack.

Title: 148. The Clan of the Cave Bear
description: A young Cro-Magnon woman is raised by Neanderthals.

Title: 149. Jake Speed
description: In a world where, unbeknownst to the public, all famous pulp fiction heroes are real, one of them, Jake Speed, agrees to help desperate Margaret Winston save her sister from sadistic white slaver Sid, who's operating in Africa.

Title: 150. The Decline of the American Empire
description: Secrets are shared and spilled when a group of academics and their partners spend a weekend at a country retreat.

Title: 151. Quiet Cool
description: A city cop Dylanne (James Remar) receives a message from his ex, Katy, a call for help. Dylanne must travel to a remote location in order to investigate the disappearances of Katy's relatives. In search for Katy's relatives, Dylanne comes face to face with hardened criminals who all are growing weed in the forests with the help of the locals and local cops.

Title: 152. Working Girls
description: A lesbian college graduate, trying to bankroll her own photography business, works as a high-priced New York City escort.

Title: 153. Link
description: When a female zoology student is invited to a remote seaside mansion to assist a primatology professor with his experiments involving chimpanzees, dangerous events start to occur, all involving the intelligent 45-year-old chimp, Link.

Title: 154. Pirates
description: The adventures of pirate Captain Red and his first mate Frog.

Title: 155. Solarbabies
description: In a post-apocalyptic future ruled by the military, a group of renegade teenage orphans find a legendary orb, Bohdai, that can supposedly bring the rain back to dried up Earth.

Title: 156. Salvador
description: A burnt-out photojournalist becomes involved in a Central American revolution.

Title: 157. The Whistle Blower
description: A war veteran tries to investigate the murder of his son who was working as a Russian translator for the British intelligence service during the Cold War. He encounters a web of deception and paranoia that seems to be impenetrable.

Title: 158. Clockwise
description: A punctuality obsessed school headmaster's day goes awry when he misses the train for an important speech he's going to make at the annual Headmasters' Conference.

Title: 159. Down by Law
description: Two men are framed and sent to jail, where they meet a murderer who helps them escape and leave the state.

Title: 160. GoBots: Battle of the Rock Lords
description: The Go-Bots fight to rescue the Rock People.

Title: 161. 8 Million Ways to Die
description: Former police detective Matthew Scudder, still recovering from his alcohol addiction, is seemingly drawn into the Los Angeles criminal underworld after stumbling upon a local drug ring.

Title: 162. Native Son
description: In 1940s Chicago, a young Black man takes a job as a chauffeur to a white family; it takes an unfortunately turn when he accidentally kills the teenage daughter of the couple and tries to cover it up.

Title: 163. The Adventures of the American Rabbit
description: To fight evil, a young rabbit can transform into a star spangled superhero.

Title: 164. From Beyond

Some at the school are trying to discover the two more miracles that would promote the late Edith Semple to sainthood; Mathews, a non-believer, wishes the school would concentrate on teaching the children. description: Three years after the Hiroshima bombing, a teenager helps a group of orphans to survive and find their new life.

description: A young couple leave their mining town home for Taipei where they struggle to eke out a living in an industrial wasteland.

description: A detective sets out to capture a psycho who kills women, but the psycho turns the tables and goes after the detective's girlfriend.

description: The story is of mentally slow man, whose life is recapped to his grand-daughter. How he meets his wife (who was a widow), earns his living and fights the injustice he and his wife face.

description: Featuring the characters from Murray Ball's "Footrot Flats". Questions will be answered as the small town of Raupo comes to life on the big screen.

description: In a barren, war torn future Earth, a soldier and his female comrade look for a lost friend in a quest that would shake their reality.

description: August 31, 1986: Dangerously unhinged serial killer Johnathan Glick gets released from the Nevada State Penitentiary on a technicality. Three days after his release Johnathan arrives in Las Vegas, Nevada. Naturally, Johnathan decides to embark on another murderous rampage that came to be known as "The Glitter Gulch Holocaust".

description: A psychiatrist donates his time to help the mentally ill street people of Hong Kong. A reporter who hears about his activities accompanies him on his rounds.

Sarraounia, queen of the Aznas, have heared about the exactions. Clever in war tactics and in witchcraft, she decides to resist and stop those mad men.

description: A beautiful wife, neglected by her husband, her sensual maid, who holds the reigns. La Bonne is an affair , an exploration, of desire, of force, and control..

description: Miguel seduces his stepdaughter Cita. While her mother, his wife, is none the wiser the younger daughter spies on their heated couplings with guilty excitement. Inevitably his attentions turn to this curious virgin.

A journalist always in search of sensational stories helps him, even if the corpse wasn't find...

Title: 319. Troppo forte
description: Oscar is a Roman guy who dreams of becoming an actor or a stuntman. Staging an accident to contact a manufacturer, he injures young actress Nancy. He remedies the damage by letting her recover in his home.

Title: 320. Righting Wrongs
description: Jason Chan, a lawyer frustrated that the law protects criminals. When a key witness and his family are murdered, he takes justice into his own hands. Cindy Si pursues him as events spiral into deadly chaos.

Title: 321. The Seventh Curse
description: An adventurer who's been inflicted with a deadly curse during a previous expedition to Thailand goes back to battle an evil sorcerer, his tribal army, and his deadly creatures.

Title: 322. Red Headed Stranger
description: Revisionist western about fallen preacher Shay, who guns down his wife Raysha for running off with another man. Wandering, he meets single mom Laurie. However, helpless sheriff Scoby wants Shay to help him fight the villainous Clavers.

Title: 323. The Malibu Bikini Shop
description: Two brothers who have just graduated from college inherit a bikini store from their aunt.

Title: 324. Vicious Lips
description: Sometime in the distant future, a fledgling band gets an opportunity for a breakthrough, if they can make it in time to a faraway planet to perform in a very popular club.

Title: 325. Dressage
description: At a decadent 1930s party, two young women make a bet with a Baron to corrupt two innocent teenagers in order to ruin their families' reputation.

Title: 326. Body Slam
description: A down-on-his-luck music manager for the fictional rock band Kick finds his luck changing when he by mistake also starts managing a successful wrestling duo.

Title: 327. The Fugitives
description: Jean is taken hostage at a bank by a foolish bank robber. As Jean left prison an hour earlier, the police assume he's the robber. Everything goes comically wrong. The robber's little daughter joins the fugitives.

Title: 328. Habeas Corpus
description: Experimental film that shows four days in the life of a man clandestinely kept in captivity. The images of his naked body alternate with those of a happy moment on a beach and with those of his captor, who spends his time looking at bodybuilding magazines.

Title: 329. Hands of Steel
description: A cyborg is programmed to kill a scientist who holds the fate of mankind in his hands. He fails and hides in a diner in a desert run by a woman who likes him. The people who sent him are after him and so is the local arm wrestling champ.

Title: 330. Ninja Terminator
description: Three martial-arts students search for the Golden Ninja Warrior, a statue reputed to have magic powers.

Title: 331. The Wind
description: A popular crime novelist moves to a historic Greek village during the off-season in order to write her next book, but gets more than she bargained for when she strongly suspects a man of committing murder.

Title: 332. Abducted
description: A woman jogger is abducted by a crazy mountain man, and taken to his cabin.

Title: 333. Eye of the Tiger
description: Returning home from prison, a Vietnam War veteran sets out to clean up his hometown which has come under the control of a violent motorcycle gang.

Title: 334. Fair Game
description: A young woman running an animal sanctuary in the outback takes her revenge on a trio of kangaroo hunters who terrorized her.

Title: 335. Jocks
description: The coach of a college tennis team is given an ultimatum: put together a winning team, or else.

Title: 336. Sex Appeal
description: Tony escapes his overbearing mother's home for bachelor life. Rebranding himself to be more appealing to the opposite sex, he cycles through relationships foiled by outrageous circumstances.

Title: 337. The Serpent's Way
description: A salesman and his son sexually abuse the generations of women of a poor family as payment for debt. Janni must see his mother, sister, niece and wife all being exploited, and the family grow bigger with the abuser's kids.

Title: 338. Legacy of Rage
description: Brandon Ma is an average Joe but his best friend, Michael, is a sinister drug dealer with a crush on Brandon's girlfriend, May. When Michael murders a dirty cop and frames his friend, sending him to jail, Brandon returns for vengeance.

Title: 339. Big Trouble
description: Insurance agent plots with client to kill her nutty husband.

Title: 340. Malcolm
description: A socially-awkward but mechanically-gifted man becomes involved in a quirky, unconventional crime.

Title: 341. The Zero Boys
description: A group of friends travel to a wilderness area to play a survival game. Soon they unexpectedly find themselves in a real-life survival situation.

Title: 342. Ratboy
description: Several shady and shallow people try to profit, one after the other, from a physically deformed teenager whose face looks like a snout of a rodent and who lives hidden in a city garbage dump, alone and miserable.

Title: 343. The Beauty of Vice
description: A conservative couple decides to leave their rural community and the wife reluctantly takes a job at a naturist resort. Soon their conservative lifestyle starts colliding with the unconventional one.

Title: 344. Sky Pirates
description: Harris starts for a flight to Bora Bora. But he gets lost in a supernatural storm. Home again, no one believes Harris' story, and his crew suspiciously denies it too. Harris is thrown in jail, but manages to escape.

Title: 345. Alone in the T-Shirt Zone
description: Michael Mikaele is a young man in a catatonic state living in a psychiatric ward where his doctor thinks her sympathies for him justify raping him. It's all part of his mad world, and we see what brought him there. He's an artist from a broken home, working for eight years at a job that he loathes, drawing pictures from sayings on sexually suggestive T-shirts. Mike's unsympathetic boss, Bill, plays bad motivational tapes over the P.A., makes Mike's girlfriend (another employee) handle him during office hours, which is espied by co-worker Joni, and refuses to let Mike have the rest of the day off even though he is clearly ill. He ties together T-shirts out the bathroom window to escape, and befriends a man, Rod, whom, unbeknownst to him, is his girlfriends father. He, however, hallucinates that the cinematographer is walking around the apartment in nothing but a towel. When the two attend a party, where everyone in the film (except his parents, doctor, and nurse) seem to be, things really start to unravel into his present nightmarish state, as well as revealing his constantly disturbed state of mind.

Title: 346. Entrails of a Beautiful Woman
description: A tortured and raped young girl mutates into a penis-headed demon and mutilates her captors.

Title: 347. Graveyard Shift
description: A vampire who works as a taxi driver meets and romances a young woman whom he turns into a fellow vamp, which prompts her jealous and estranged husband to try to kill both of them.

Title: 348. Nagina
description: The film revolves around Rajni, a shape-shifting cobra who marries a civilian to avenge the death of her spouse at the hands of an evil saint.

Title: 349. Millionaires' Express
description: In early twentieth century China, various criminals with different goals are connected to a Shanghai train, with many rich people on-board.

Title: 350. His Motorbike, Her Island
description: After a failed romance, a temperamental young biker meets a carefree rural girl while riding through her island hometown and gets her obsessed about riding a motorcycle.

Title: 351. Flower and Snake: White Uniform Rope Slave
description: A perverted dentist and his assistant drug and sexually abuse patients. The dentist becomes obsessed with a busty patient and her lesbian lover, subjecting them to abuse with classical music.

Title: 352. Time Escapade: 5 Seconds Til Climax
description: A young woman who is prone to romantic dreams involving her supervisor time-travels from 1986 to 2001 and becomes involved with a private investigator who is working on a divorce case and is having his own marital difficulties.

Title: 353. Mouna Ragam
description: Divya, a woman grieving over the death of her lover, is convinced into an arranged marriage with Chandra Kumar. Over a year the couple attempt to adjust to each other's presence and live with each other.

Title: 354. Bad Girls Dormitory
description: Inmates at a women's prison run by a corrupt warden and her gang of sadistic guards plan a breakout.

Title: 355. The Night of the Pencils
description: This films tells the true story of seven teenagers who agitated for reduced student bus fares under two different regimes in Argentina, with tragic results. At first succeeding under the government of Isabel Peron, their protests draw hostile attention from the military regime that overthrows Peron. The ensuing crackdown on student social activists is demonstrated when police break up a school dance wielding swords on horseback. Later, six students are kidnapped in the middle of the night, and the police deceitfully claim ignorance about their whereabouts. Pablo (Alejo Garcia Pintos), a seventh member of the group is later arrested and learns that they have been brutally tortured by authorities. He survives to tell their story, but the six are never found, numbering among the hundreds of students who were kidnapped and are still missing.

Title: 356. Land of Doom
description: Earth has been ravaged by a nuclear war, and a feminist warrior is forced to join up with a soldier of fortune in her journey to find a rumored "paradise" as they battle gangs of rampaging bandits.

Title: 357. Delizia
description: Italian fashion model living in New York decides to sell a villa located in the central Italian countryside and to make it back to their homeland.

Title: 358. Sexy Battle Girls
description: Mirai, a high school girl, is transferred to an upscale private girls school. She soon finds out the school not only cultivates young minds, but also supplies young bodies to rich politicians. The school's headmaster ripped apart her family. She undergoes special training, and fights her way to sweet revenge.

Title: 359. Deux enfoirés à Saint-Tropez
description: Julius takes his best friend Paul, fresh out of prison, to the South of France for a vacation. But new girls, old flames, lies and a couple of stolen statuettes await.

Title: 360. Summer Camp Nightmare
description: A group of campers revolt against their strict camp director and take over the camp for themselves.

Title: 361. Star Crystal
description: Crew members aboard a space ship encounter an alien life form intent on killing them.

Title: 362. Alexandra
description: A company manager raped his own newly appointed secretary.

Title: 363. Descent Into Hell
description: A couple formed by a 40-year-old former writer who has fallen into alcoholism, and a beautiful young woman 20 years his junior, is struggling. They will meet again after a dramatic event, which occurred during a stay in Haiti.

Title: 364. Opposing Force
description: A major avenges a woman officer wronged by a brutal instructor of an escape-and-evasion course.

Title: 365. Alien Predator
description: Three American friends travelling through Spain get stuck in a remote town where something very dangerous is changing the town's people.

Title: 366. Beautiful Sisters: Flesh Slaves
description: A maniac breaks into the apartment of two sisters and abuses them sexually and physically until they turn the tables.

Title: 367. Ricky 1
description: In this parody of the Rocky films, Ricky Wanero is a male gigolo and stripper who sets out to beat "The Champ" in the boxing ring.

Title: 368. Magic Crystal
description: The Russians and the Hong Kong authorities are after a mysterious rock discovered in Athens, Greece, which holds strange powers.

Title: 369. Dingding lang ang pagitan
description: A respected man with an infertile wife carries on an affair with a nightclub ago-ago dancer.

Title: 370. Aakhree Raasta
description: An ex-convict is bent on revenge against the people responsible for his wrongful imprisonment but is pit against his estranged son who is now a police officer.

Title: 371. Courier
description: A teenage boy goes about his life during the fall of communism in the Soviet Union.

Title: 372. El amor brujo
description: In a Gypsy village, the fathers of Candela and José promise their children to each other. Years later, the unfaithful José marries Candela but while defending his lover Lucía in a brawl, he is stabbed to death. Carmelo, who secretly loves Candela since he was a boy, is arrested while helping José and unfairly sent to prison. Four years later he is released and declares his love for Candela. However, the woman is cursed by a bewitched love and every night she goes to the place where José died to dance with his ghost.

Title: 373. Valhalla
description: Through Loki's treachery, two children in the Viking age find themselves spirited away into the world of Norse Mythology.

Title: 374. Nattseilere
description: On the island of Senja in Northern Norway in 1877, Båremor, a 14-year-old girl is washed ashore almost dead. No-one knows her and she remembers nothing of her past. A poor family of fishermen take care of her, but she never feels at home among these coastal people. Soon she meets infamous Bårr.

Title: 375. Ninja Dragon
description: Major figures in the ninja community are being slaughtered. 3 ninjas are trying to figure out what evil people want to bring an end to all ninjas, and also rescue the kidnapped daughter of one of their mentors.

Title: 376. Naam
description: Follows the story of Vicky, who gets entrapped in a criminal plot after he leaves his country for work.

Title: 377. Martial Arts of Shaolin
description: In ancient China, Zhi Ming trains at the legendary Northern Shaolin temple to avenge the death of his father at the hands of a nefarious magistrate.

Title: 378. Karma
description: Jailer Vishwa trains three death row inmates to hunt down escaped terrorist Michael, who killed his grandchildren.

Title: 379. The Tomb
description: A tomb robber steals artifacts from an unmarked tomb in Egypt and sells them to different archeologists in America. This displeases the immortal woman whose tomb has been desecrated, so she follows the artifacts to America, where she busies herself extracting revenge for the theft.

Title: 380. The Majorettes
description: A high school majorettes are being methodically killed by a mysterious masked figure. Meanwhile, a local gang are involved in suspicious activities around the school.

Title: 381. Kulang sa dilig
description: Cristina is being sexually deprived by her husband and she wants to know why. In the process of searching for an answer, she becomes a nude model for an older artist and has an affair with him.

Title: 383. Project A-Ko
description: A plucky, super-powered redhead finds herself saving her crybaby best friend from an amorous, bikini armor-clad classmate at their new school and aliens seeking to bring her home.

Title: 384. Vilde, the Wild One
description: In a rural western town in 1890 a woman has a mute old daughter after relations with her step father, which in his need of money, wants to sell them off to a rich skin tradesman. While resisting this, the woman turns lame.

Title: 385. Sleepwalk
description: A woman is hired to transcribe an ancient Chinese manuscript. She finds that little by little, the manuscript has powers that begin to take over her life.

Title: 386. Un macho en la cárcel de mujeres
description: A man is locked up in a women's prison by mistake.

Title: 387. Mulberry
description: A neglectful gambler's wife struggles to maintain their household in a rural village, leading to compromising choices that draw the attention of a vengeful local servant.

Title: 388. Armed Response
description: One of Tanaka's underlings has stolen a rare statuette that he had planned to use as a peace offering between the local Yakusa and Chinese Tong. He hires two private investigators to exchange ransom money to recover the statuette, but the trade goes down bad and Clay Roth is killed. This angers Roth's brothers and father, all combat veterans, and they go after the people responsible.

Title: 389. Vikram
description: Vikram, a cop who is mourning the death of his wife, is assigned to retrieve a missile. He is aided by a highly educated engineer Preethi, who holds the knowledge to disarm the nuke, in his mission.

Title: 390. Trespasses
description: A man swear revenge over two drifters for killing his son.

Title: 391. The Aurora Encounter
description: In 1897, residents of a small Texas town are visited by a benevolent extraterrestrial being whose presence divides the community.

Title: 393. Roller Blade
description: In a futuristic society, rebels fighting against a fascist state are aided by a group of roller-skating nuns called the Bod Sisters.

Title: 394. The Female Executioner
description: Martine is a tough female cop trying to solve the kidnapping of a young girl by a gang of pornographers.

Title: 395. Devil Story
description: A deformed man living with his mother in the countryside roams the woods killing indiscriminately. A couple spend the night nearby, and the wife goes through a nightmarish experience involving a black horse, a mummy, and the deformed man.

Title: 396. Vendetta
description: A sexy stuntwoman gets herself thrown into prison to avenge the death of her sister.

Title: 397. Bröderna Mozart
description: An opera director tries to put on a highly unconventional production of Mozart's Don Giovanni, but the cast and crew think all his ideas are terrible.

Title: 398. The Whoopee Boys
description: Two obnoxious and dim-witted misfits attempt to save a school for needy children by attempting to sneak into the wealthy high society of Palm Beach to get the money needed for their cause.

Title: 399. The Last Women of the Philippines
description: Two young sisters are shipwrecked on a deserted island with their teacher Ms. Muro.

Title: 400. Super Mario Brothers: Great Mission to Rescue Princess Peach
description: The Mario Bros.Mario and Luigi go to another dimension, and must now rescue Princess Peach from King Bowser Koopa.

Title: 401. 27 horas
description: Jon, a twenty-year-old boy from San Sebastián, gets up at seven in the morning and, from that moment on, we watch how he lives his friendship with Patxi and Maite, love, family relationships, his confusion about the future and, above all, his dark passion for drugs.

Title: 402. Max My Love
description: A married French woman takes a zoo chimp named Max to be her lover.

Title: 403. You'll Die at Midnight
description: A man becomes aware that his wife has been having an affair resulting in a violent argument. Shortly afterward she is murdered and he becomes the chief suspect.

Title: 404. The Boss' Wife
description: Joel Keefer is a stockbroker trying to climb the corporate ladder. Only one thing is stopping him: his boss' beautiful, flirtatious wife.

Title: 405. Lucky Seven
description: Seven child martial arts experts - Small Pepper, Bill Sh*t, Rocky, Hairy, Two Feet, Mut Head and Fatty - try to return a stolen diamond to its rightful owner.

Title: 406. Evil Senses
description: Manuel, a hitman, kills his pursuer and steals a briefcase containing blackmail documents. He flees to Italy, hides in a brothel, and develops feelings for a woman named Vittoria.

Title: 407. Namukku Parkkan Munthiri Thoppukal
description: A man falls in love with his new neighbor but then finds that her family life is difficult.

Title: 408. Terror and Black Lace
description: Isabel Martinez (Maribel Guardia) is a naive stay-at-home wife, who constantly is being mistreated by her abusive husband, what they do not know is their quiet and polite neighbor is actually a crazed sex maniac.

Title: 409. Bach et Bottine
description: When her grandma enters a nursing home, orphan Fanny moves in with Uncle Jonathan as he preps for a Bach recital. She befriends neighbor Sean and adds more pets to her collection, including her skunk Broccoli.

Title: 410. Thunder Run
description: Charlie, a Korean War veteran, is driving a truck which is transporting plutonium from Nevada to Arizona. But there are a bunch of terrorists who want to steal the stuff...

Title: 411. Rosa Luxemburg
description: After years of political agitation, Rosa Luxemburg, Karl Liebknecht, and Leo Jogiches form a revolutionary German party, the Spartacists.

Title: 412. Grandi magazzini
description: A series of vignettes set in a huge shopping mall.

Title: 413. The Panther Squad
description: A squad of female mercenaries take on an organization called Space Clean, which is dedicated to stopping space exploration.

Title: 414. Rosa la rose: fille publique
description: A Paris prostitute with a lenient pimp faces a dilemma when she falls for a young worker, forcing her to choose between love and her established life.

Title: 415. Young Dragons: Kung Fu Kids
description: Ah Kuo, Xiao Yu and Chubby are three country bumpkins living in the mountains with their cantankerous grandfather, who teaches the boys about discipline, dedication and devotion through martial arts training. Over the years, the boys have done a lot of kung fu training and have gained much in the ways of martial arts, including good health and a bond that keeps them inseparable. However, during an argument involving who is suppose to feed Grandpa's pet bird, it escapes and now they fear punishment. Not wanting to get into anymore trouble, they flee from home in an attempt to find the bird and bring it back so Grandpa won't know and this prompts the boys to take a trip to the big city, where their country way of life causes them to get into trouble and clash with the locals a little bit because they have no knowledge of city life. During the trip, the boys discover their Grandma and little sister Cheng-Cheng living the good life and so she takes them in to look after them, but their happy times together won't last: a notorious crime syndicate that the Young Dragons bumped into earlier has some unfinished business with them and now, they must utilize everything their grandfather taught them as they fight to protect themselves and their family from the very thugs who seek to destroy their unity.

Title: 416. Silk
description: Silk, the toughest cop in Honolulu, busts small time smugglers only to reveal a larger syndicate smuggling Asian mobsters into the States by buying the identities of Hawaiian citizens.

Title: 417. Akrep
description: Murat is a handsome tour guide. He takes a job on the mob leader Temel's boat. Temel's wife Sadiye fancies him, and Murat is also attracted to her beauty. They start an affair and meet in the boat when Temel is absent. For money laundering purposes, Temel transfers all his assets to Sadiye.

Title: 418. Girls School Screamers
description: Seven college girls spend the weekend at an elegant estate which begins as a fun filled adventure but ends in a nightmare of gut-wrenching terror.

Title: 419. A Man and a Woman: 20 Years Later
description: Jean-Louis and Anne had a fling years ago. Now he races cars; she's a director making a film about their past romance. She contacts him for permission as she struggles to recapture their former passion through filming.

Title: 420. Cours privé
description: Jeanne Kern is a history teacher in a private mixed class. Passionately provocative, she does not ignore the effect she has on men.

Title: 421. Knife Under the Throat
description: Erotic models are stalked by a maniac.

Title: 422. Akli Miklós
description: A jester's adventures in the court of Franz Joseph I.

Title: 423. Car Trouble
description: In the throes of a midlife crisis, a man buys a new Jaguar, and it immediately becomes his new love. What he doesn't know is that his wife is as attracted to the Jaguar salesman as he is to the car.

Title: 424. On Valentine's Day
description: Prequel to Horton Foote's '1918'. Two lovers elope on Valentine's day 1917. At Christmas the family are reunited but there is still anger amongst the parents about the elopment, but a reconciliation soon sets in.

Title: 425. Una storia ambigua
description: Countess Anna Guerrieri, a rich and provocative noblewoman, marries Romano, an important fascist who is very loyal to the party.

Title: 426. The Photograph
description: A young furrier leaves Castoria in 1971 to emigrate to France to live with a relative. He finds a photograph, leading to a confrontation with his relative.

Title: 427. Halik sa pisngi ng langit
description: Based on a true-to-life story, the film tackles a controversial subject: an affair between a young barrio lass and a priest.

Title: 428. Dreamaniac
description: A heavy-metal musician makes a deal with a satanic succubus to make him successful with women, in return for the succubus being able to feed on the girls.

Title: 429. Low Blow
description: Leo Fong plays a private investigator who is in search of a young girl kidnapped by a religious cult. Destined to save her, he teams up with a Vietnam vet, a pro-boxing champ and a former cop to save her...

Title: 430. Sasti Dulhan Mahenga Dulha
description: A father in Nagpur struggles to marry his 3 daughters as he lacks dowry money. His eldest gets police to arrest a groom's father asking for dowry, hurting the family's reputation. The 3 leave home separately, blaming themselves.

Title: 431. Unfaithful Wife
description: What if your wife were unfaithful and her lover were your best friend? The friendship of two men is put to a crucial test when one throws caution to the wind and gives in to his passion for the other's wife.

Title: 432. Majstor i Sampita
description: A young reporter girl nicknamed Cream Pie writes an article on money-making in small businesses. She meets a married shoemaker who falls for her and steals his wife's money for their love nest, but Cream Pie discovers it by accident and takes it to the newspapers' office. Shoemaker's wife interferes into this whole confusion and the whole fuss resolves at a hospital.

Title: 433. Khamosh
description: When a starlet is murdered on a film location, a detective arrives to investigate the cast and crew.

Title: 434. Hitlar
description: The son of Hitler, Hitlar, wreaks havoc in a Punjabi village.

Title: 435. The Flavor of Corn
description: Lorenzo, a handsome first-year professor in an isolated Italian village, falls under the spell of his most beguiling pupil, a dark-haired, starry-eyed 12-year-old named Duilio. As Lorenzo's relationship with his heartless girlfriend deteriorates, he finds himself walking the fields with his loving student. When their idyllic friendship is questioned by Duilio's suspicious stepmother, Lorenzo is brought to a crisis of conscience.

Title: 436. Mavi Melek
description: The love story of a blind girl and a murderous man.

Title: 437. The Night Stalker
description: A tough homicide cop is assigned to track down a serial killer who is murdering prostitutes.

Title: 438. Happy Hour
description: A chemist experimenting with different formulas stumbles upon an ingredient that, when added to beer, makes it absolutely irresistible. Before he realizes it, an international spy is after him to try to get the formula for himself.

Title: 439. Portfolio
description: Top models star in a drama revealing the guts of the fashion world.

Title: 440. Trial on the Road
description: A Soviet POW joins the partisan guerrillas and proves his loyalty fighting the Germans.

Title: 441. Golden Eighties
description: Employees and clients of a commercial gallery only live for love; they dream it, proclaim it, sing it and dance it. Experience the encounters, reunions, passions and disappointments of a malicious chorus of girls and a group of idle boys.

Title: 442. Murder in the Dark
description: A womanizing reporter investigates death of his friend in Copenhagen's sporting district and the detective finds himself caught between clunky ordeals of police and gangsters involved in drug trafficking.

Title: 443. Voyage to Nowhere
description: The movie tells the story of a family of comedians that work in the towns of Spain during the 40's and 50's. Life gets very tough for them since they cannot compete any longer with cinema. We assist to the end of an era.

Title: 444. Terror Force Commando
description: A Cameroonese police officer (Alphonse Beni) and a CIA agent (Richard Harrison) try to prevent the Pope from being assassinated by Italian terrorists during his African tour.

Title: 445. Parting Glances
description: As Michael and Robert, a gay couple in New York, prepare for Robert's departure for a two-year work assignment in Africa, Michael must face Robert's true motives for leaving while dealing with their circle of eccentric friends, including Nick, who is living with AIDS.

Title: 446. Yakuza Ladies
description: While her husband is in prison doing time, Tamaki, the wife of a yakuza capo, runs her spouse's gang with an iron hand. Meanwhile, Makoto, her younger sister, marries a member of a rival band after being raped by him. The two sisters, united by blood ties but married to enemy yakuzas, will ultimately have to decide whose side they're on.

Title: 447. The Supernaturals
description: In 1865, In Alabama, during the American Civil War, Confederate soldiers are held captive and forced by the 44th Union Army commander to walk through a field with landmines to blow up them. The boy Jeremy is wearing a Confederate uniform and is also forced to make the crossing. When his mother Melanie runs to save him, she steps on a landmine and Jeremy uses his mysterious ability to revive her. On the present days, a rookie platoon commanded by Sgt. Leona Hawkins in training in the same spot and will camp, and Pvt. Ray Ellis finds the place strange, but Sgt. Hawkins is reluctant to move. Out of the Blue, Melanie reappears and meets Ellis since he recalls her husband. During the night, a mysterious fog surrounds their camp. Soon they are attacked by a horde of zombies and Ellis finds a means to stop the aggressors. Will he succeed?

Title: 448. Singing the Blues in Red
description: A singer swaps the political intimidation of working in East Germany for the equally controlling capitalist music industry in the West.

Title: 449. Impure Thoughts
description: Four male friends are reunited after not being in contact with each other for several years. However, the meeting place is Purgatory, the afterlife state of limbo between heaven and hell. In Purgatory, these friends reflect on their pasts while they were living. They especially focus on their years in Catholic School and their coming-of-age. This movie talks a lot about sexual issues. One of the characters is an eighteen-year old sent to Vietnam who dies without ever losing his virginity, and a middle-aged, homosexual alcoholic playwright who still has problems dealing with his identity.

Title: 450. Report to Mother
description: The story revolves around the incidents following the death of a young Naxalite, upon whose death his friends travel to the village where his mother lives to inform her of the death of her only son.

Title: 451. Sultanat
description: Shah is the leader of the Mugal tribe in Asia; when he gets news that bandit, Razoulli and his gang are coming to launch an attack on their region, he is petrified and asks his people to vacate but General Khalid assures him not to worry much and darlingly challenge Razoulli overpowering them. But Razoulli manages to escape and in the process abducts Khalid's pregnant wife, make sure she gives birth to a baby boy, bring him up, teaches him all the skills to become a certify warrior and name him Sultan. While Khalid re-marry Jenny and they are proud parents to Samir who is sent abroad for studies. Khalid then takes an oath to kill Razoulli and the duo combat each other on many occasions but Razoulli have always manages to escape. Meanwhile the brave Sultan takes a fantasy to queen Shehzadi Yasmeen, is made to enter a death race but emerge victorious and in the process abducts Yasmeen but eventually both fall in love. Then Sultan receive news that Razoulli was killed by Khalid - Sultan then swears to destroy Khalid. When Sultan gets informed that Samir and his beloved, Zarina is returning from abroad he attempt to abduct them albeit unsuccessful. Shortly after Sultan and Khalid begins their fierce battle against each other - a battle between father and son - fully well knowing that only one shall survive.

Title: 452. Byeon Kang-soe
description: Kang-soe and his wife Ong-nyeo settle down in a new village but tragedy strikes when Kang-soe dies while chopping wood. Ong-nyeo announces that she will marry any man who can successfully bury her husband. Many men try to accomplish the task, but die in the process. Ong-nyeo is in despair over not being able to complete the funeral preparations when her husband appears before her apparently alive again

Title: 453. Let's Hope It's a Girl
description: Elena lives in a villa in Tuscany with multiple female relatives. When her former husband comes back to visit, family disagreements seem to unravel.

Title: 454. The Messenger
description: When his girlfriend dies of a drug overdose, a former Green Beret decides to take vengeance on the drug gangs responsible for her death.

Title: 455. Lola
description: Lola, a factory worker, finally decides to run away from Mario, the drunk and aggressive man she loves.

Title: 456. Monster Dog
description: A rock star returns to his childhood home to shoot a music video while a pack of wild dogs are on the loose killing off the local residents.

Title: 457. Donselya
description: A family is plagued not only by economic but also by sexual problems.

Title: 458. Mr. Vampire II
description: Grave robbers unearth preserved vampires. Transporting child vampire, its spell breaks, befriending locals. Parent vampires awaken, escape. Herbalist pursues to destroy them.

Title: 459. Andheri Raat Mein Diya Tere Haath Mein
description: Two friends who, in the greed of money, get involved with the underworld and live a life full of luxuries. The story takes a turn when one of them realizes its adverse consequences and wants to pursue a normal life.

Title: 460. Memoirs of a Sinner
description: A recently resurrected corpse recounts his life story, focusing on his strange relationship with a murderous alter-ego.

Title: 461. Crystal Heart
description: A 22 year old man who has lived inside a crystal room because of a rare illness, meets an up and coming rock star, and the two fall in love.

Title: 462. Kariyila Kattu Pole
description: Deputy Superintendent of Police Achuthankutty tries to solve the mystery of film director Harikrishnan's death. Three women are the main suspects.

Title: 463. Voyeur
description: A well-to-do, shut-in thirty-something faces city life, family secrets and his own quirks when he is finally thrown out by his parents.

Title: 464. Aladdin
description: Updating of the old "Aladdin" Arabian Nights tale, as a teenager in modern-day Miami finds a magic lantern and out pops a genie, who's been asleep for 200 years and in his gratitude grants the boy several wishes.

Title: 465. Hollywood Zap
description: Story of two friends, one searching for his father, the other searching for the ultimate sexual video game competition.

Title: 466. Choke Canyon
description: A "cowboy"-scientist is fighting a corporation who wants to dump atomic waste on a piece of land he has leased.

Title: 467. Captain Barbell
description: Teng Teng is an orphan who works by collecting junk from the streets. One day, as a reward for his good deeds, he is given the magic barbell (dumbbell) which empowers him to be Captain Barbell, who fights evil forces in the land.

Title: 468. The Longshot
description: Four losers borrow money from gangsters to bet on a "sure thing", but lose. The gangsters go after them to get their money.

Title: 469. Ek Chadar Maili Si
description: Rani, a loving wife, lives a peaceful life with her husband Trilok, a horse carriage driver. However, Rani's life takes a new turn when Trilok is killed.

Title: 470. Fatmagül'ün Suçu Ne
description: Story of a village girl who transforms into a courageous and independent woman and fights against the men who destroyed her life.

Title: 471. The Graduates
description: The love story of two tenth-graders in Romania before the revolution.

Title: 472. Foreign Body
description: An unemployed Indian engineer emigrates to England to find work and through a series of circumstances, ends up impersonating a doctor to win the attention of an attractive young woman.

Title: 473. Loose Ends
description: A film crew arrives at a beach resort area to shoot a movie, and encounters trouble with the local teens.

Title: 474. Korkusuz
description: Unofficial Turkish remake of Rambo: First Blood Part II (1985)

Title: 475. Recruits
description: A Canadian sex comedy in the tradition of "Police Academy".

Title: 476. Chronicle of Amorous Accidents
description: Set in the summer months preceding the September 1939 outbreak of World War II in Polish part of Lithuania. A young highschool lad, Witek, is hoping to pass the entrance exams to the university. His love interest is Alina, his high-school colleague.

Title: 477. Twist again à Moscou
description: Igor, who manages a fancy hotel and is on the take, has to juggle several problems at once. He has a two-hour window to get his ill-got gain out of the hotel, he must misdirect and obstruct the inquiries of a Party auditor who suspects that all is not above board, and he must keep out of sight and out of trouble his interloping and troublesome young brother-in-law, who arrives unannounced with barrels of rotten herring.

Title: 478. Instant Justice
description: Scott is a US Marine who travels Spain to see his sister Kim, after many years of separation. But she is dead, and there is nothing else to arrive him. Alone in the Madrid's streets, Scott will search for the killers, will try to reveal the reason of the murder of his dear sister, and for revenge for himself.

Title: 479. Female Market: Imprisonment
description: Unlucky women are imprisoned in a warehouse in preparation for being later sold into slavery.

Title: 480. Sekula i njegove zene
description: A village blacksmith Sekula, hard-muscled but soft-hearted, has everything but the luck when it comes to love. Many women pass through his house, but keep just enough to give birth to another child, and then run away from the life that briefly stranded. A local spinster of ill health, a belly dancer, a veterinarian experienced in castration of bulls, and finally, a singing star-to-be. Sekula is truly in loved with this singer with large eyes and a slim waist, but she only dreams of money in her buxom, a record contract and the newspaper headlines.

Title: 481. Jönssonligan dyker upp igen
description: Criminal trio strike at furniture store, discover a secret network for shipping computers to the Soviet Union.

Title: 482. Naseeb Apna Apna
description: A domineering man marries his son to a simple village girl. But when she arrives at his house in the city, she discovers that he is already married to an attractive city woman.

Title: 483. To Sleep So as to Dream
description: An aging silent film actress hires a private eye and his wacky but helpful assistant to track down her missing daughter, Bellflower. The two follow a succession of bizarre, obscure clues, until they track down the location of the kidnappers and the daughter.

Title: 484. Lovedolls Superstar
description: The Lovedolls return from their untimely demise in this 1986 sequel to "Desperate Teenage Lovedolls". Patch Kelley (Janet Housden) becomes Patch Christ, the leader of an acid-damaged religious cult who rescues has been Kitty Karryall from a boozy, wasted life. Rocking by Redd Kross, Sonic Youth, Meat Puppets, Dead Kennedys, & more! You can't kill a Lovedoll, babe... because Superstars never die!

Title: 485. Flower and Snake 3: Punishment
description: When successful business man refuses to save the business of his former business partner, his wife, a private teacher of written arts, and her student are kidnapped. The former business partner plans to execute his revenge by forcing both women into sexual slavery and forcefully train them into becoming SM porn stars.

Title: 486. Hovering Over the Water
description: Laura Rossellini, a widow from Rome, vacations on the Algarve coast one hot summer. One day while sunbathing, she finds a wounded man named Robert drifting in the surf on a rubber raft. She takes him home, and, after he is revived, learns his story. As they talk, their mutual attraction grows, until a group of armed men suddenly arrives looking for Robert.

Title: 487. Mazhe Ghar Mazha Sansar
description: A modern girl from a conservative family gets engaged to Prasad. After postponing their wedding for his sister's marriage, they wed but face conflicts when his pregnant sister moves in with them.

Title: 488. Windaria
description: An ambitious young farmer becomes an agent in a pointless war between two nations, and tragedy ensues.

Title: 489. Kangaroo
description: A mild-mannered English conscientious objector moves to what he feels will be the relative calm of Australia after World War I, but gets caught in the middle of violent battles between the rising trade unions and fascist groups.

Title: 490. The Horse Thief
description: A Tibetan man struggles to provide for his family.

Title: 491. Nude City
description: This sex-drama depicts the experiences of bold dancers working in the "Nude City" nightclub. She's a paid model and she uses her body for everything it's worth. The best exotic actress shows off her claim to fame.

Title: 492. The Dairy of Zacarias
description: En el barrio no hay lugar más visitado que la lechería 'Las Glorias de Don Zacarias'. Don Juan y su ayudante Mariano adulteran los productos famosos de la lechería sin imaginar las consecuencias que esto les traería.

Title: 493. The Return of Billy Jack
description: Billy Jack returns to bring down a child pornography ring headed by the Godfather of Godfathers.

Title: 494. A Tale of Love
description: A young working girl moves in with her boyfriend while taking care of her brothers and father. Things get complicated when she falls in love with another young boy.

Title: 495. Mama is boos!
description: When a wife and mother of two finds out her husband has an affair, she tries to make his life a living hell.

Title: 496. Snake and Whip
description: A beautiful young secretary is propositioned by her boss. When she rejects him with a slap, he plots revenge and traps her into becoming his sex-slave.

Title: 497. Jaal
description: Shankar Verma lives a poor lifestyle with his mom, Shanti, in India after His father, Sathpal, leaves the family for a courtesan by the name of Meenabai. Years later, Shankar has now grown up and finds himself the object of affection of two beautiful women, Sunita - who is wealthy and is the daughter of Bhanu Pratap Singh, and Madhu - who is poor and lives with her parents, Hariya and Tara. Both women think that Shankar is in love with them. Shankar is hired by a wealthy woman named Amita who wants him to spy on Bhanu Pratap, his sons, Balram and Jackie, and his partner, Kedar. Shankar goes on this task and reports his findings to Amita regularly.
