description: After the nuclear annihilation of the planet, the last member of a small society of survivors finds himself trapped in an underground control room, where he recounts the history of his world through musical numbers.

Title: 790. Kong-Fu Wonder Child
description: A clan leader's spirit essence is captured by an evil wizard and it's up to the Kung fu Wonder Child and her friends to save the day.

Title: 791. Hong Kil-dong
description: The illegitimate son of a nobleman defends peasants from greedy rulers, confounds local bandits, and struggles for permission to marry his tasty upper-crust sweetheart despite their vast societal differences. Then ninjas arrive.

Title: 792. Oomai Vizhigal
description: Police officer and media team expose child trafficking ring at "Picnic Village" resort serving politicians, facing threats while gathering evidence to solve the case.

Title: 793. Joey
description: Conflict with his hard-drinking father, a working-class former musician, drives a talented teenager to run away from home to embark on his own musical career.

Title: 794. Italian Fast Food
description: The Film centers around an American-style fast food restaurant in Milan, the employees who work there and the clients that frequent the place.

Title: 795. The American Bride
description: Edoardo meets and immediately falls in love for Edith. They soon decide to marry. During the wedding Edoardo knows Anna, Edith's best friend and wife of her brother. This last is a fake marriage since Sacha is homosexual. Incredibly Edoardo loses his mind for Anna, and they become soon lovers. The two couples spend time together in Venezia. Edoardo is continuously shared between Edith and Anna. But this won't take long.

Title: 796. Plastposen
description: An ordinary man Reinert, goes out in the morning for throwing his garbage in a plastic-bag. At the same time a bank-robbery happens in the neighborhood. The loot from the robbery is also kept in a plastic-bag.

Title: 797. La vie dissolue de Gérard Floque
description: On the day he loses his job in advertising agency, Gérard Floque returns home to find that his infant daughter has been arrested for drugs trafficking and his wife is having an affair with a TV presenter. Gérard's only comfort in this time of mid-life crisis is his colleague, a young punk girl named Martine.

Title: 798. Dosti Dushmani
description: The friendship of three best friends develops a rift due to a misunderstanding created by their common enemy.

Title: 799. Black and White
description: A shy accountant strikes up a volatile relationship with a masseur at the health club where they both work.

Title: 800. Ai City
description: In the future, Kei and Ai run for their lives, Ai is a small girl she holds a deep secret that can destroy the world. The world is populated by Headmeters people that have psychic powers and strong strength. When Headmeters fight their strength is shown on their forehead but Kei's for some reason never went beyond level five but other Headmeters's strength has. Kei has the ability to increase his strength when Ai gets in trouble.

Title: 801. Suhagan
description: Sisters Janaki and Jyoti live with their parents. Janaki marries Ramu despite loving wealthy Murli. Unhappy with simple farm life, she leaves after having a child. Ramu weds Jyoti, who raises the child. Janaki later regrets leaving.

Title: 802. Night of Terror
description: A family of sadistic psychopaths seeks out victims for its gruesome brain operations.

Title: 803. El federal de caminos
description: Con la rabia y frustración a cuestas, un patrullero federal de carretera lucha contra la banda de narcotraficantes que un día a sangre fría le arrebataron la vida a su padre y hermano.

Title: 804. Madame De Sade: She Beast in Hell
description: A man is kidnapped by his ex-girlfriend on his wedding day and sexually tortured. His wife runs into him after 3 months and he finds out that he still loves her, but can no longer perform sexually for her as he's been "broken" and turned into a sex-slave.

Title: 805. Beverly Hills Girls
description: A pair of "stories" from a talent agent in Hollywood. The first involves a young female band and what they must do to get a record deal. The second involves the narrator talent agent in a position of losing her agency; that is until her girls come up with an ingenious plan as to how to infiltrate the blackmailer's hideout and win the agency back.

Title: 806. Trade Secrets
description: In the Médoc, a young woman is found drowned. An accident, her influential family of winegrowers maintains. Or rather murder, as the American inspector Morrison suspects. If so, why? What secrets this family keeps?

Title: 807. If Looks Could Kill
description: Private eye George accepts the job to shadow a woman and to film her on video. But it's a set-up: the film is manipulated and used against him when the woman is killed. He has to prove his innocence against a load of circumstantial evidence.

Title: 808. Molly O
description: Nicky, a music student in Rome, together with two friends, wants to establish herself in the world of music and entertainment. Meeting an American rock star will change everything.

Title: 809. The Stabilizer
description: Peter Goldson, aka The Stabilizer, searches for drug smuggler Greg Rainmaker. Rainmaker killed Goldson's fiancee by kicking her with his spiked shoes, and now Goldson wants revenge.

Title: 810. Cool Change
description: Park ranger Steve Mitchell is torn between Lee, a beautiful sly political aide from Melbourne who supports the government's decision to turn the local grazing areas into a national park, and his old flame Joanna, a rancher who opposes it.

Title: 811. The Shogunate's Harem
description: Genshiro must find the mother of the late Shogun's child and abort it to save his love.

Title: 812. Anokha Rishta
description: Mary, an inmate of an orphanage run by nuns, is good at studies and is artistically talented, her education so far has been sponsored by a philanthropist. Her sponsor, a rich old man who she has never met but has only corresponded with through the nuns, passes away, laving her dreams of a college education in shambles. Mr. Robert Brown (Bob) who is now at the helm of affairs of his father's business agrees to continue her sponsorship. Bob is a confirmed bachelor and Mary is drawn to him by some mysterious force.

Title: 813. Innocenza
description: A beautiful new teacher arrives in a small, traditional village in Switzerland. Luca immediately falls in love with her - until he realizes that his best friend receives as much of her (professional) attention. But the sleazy mayor is after her too. When she refuses his blunt advances, he's out for revenge by ruining her reputation, using the love of her pupils.

Title: 814. Dancing in the Dark
description: The present unfolds along with scenes from the past in this intense psychological drama about Edna, a woman in the hospital who each day writes down her memories.

Title: 815. Werther
description: In a city of the north coast of Spain, a young teacher teaches Greek lessons at an elite private school. He is a romantic and melancholy man, who lives alone in the old house of his sailor ancestors on the other side of the bay.

Title: 816. Is It Easy to Be Young?
description: Portrayal of rebellious teenagers growing up under Communist rule in Latvia.

Title: 817. Foxtrap
description: Private detective is hired by rich man to find his niece, who has disappeared while traveling in Europe.

Title: 818. Aayiram Kannukal
description: Anu started foreseeing some murders to be happened through her dreams and the resulting incidents that leads to the murderer forms the plot of the movie.

Title: 819. El orden cómico
description: A presidential candidate whose main campaign promise is to end crime, one day when he arrives home with his wife, he finds the lifeless body of his son who had come to rob him. The young man was a drug addict, just what the candidate promises to end if elected. So he decides to hide the body until the elections, to avoid ruining his candidacy.

Title: 820. Pyar Ke Do Pal
description: Twins separated by a court order meet at camp and decide to reunite their parents, unaware of the dark secret that drove them apart years before.

Title: 821. Lily Tomlin
description: Follows the preparations for Lily Tomlin's prospective hit show / one-woman performance piece "The Search for Signs of Intelligent Life in the Universe" until the premiere of the show on Broadway, in September 1985.

Title: 822. The Young Riders
description: Young skinny riders hired to carry the mail at a fast gallop for 10 miles relay.

Title: 823. Geierwally
description: A young maiden is the victim of an arranged marriage and runs away to the mountains to avoid her fate.

Title: 824. Vera
description: Based on the life of Brazilian poet Anderson Bigode Herzer, the movie tells the story of Bauer, a trans man who navigates a difficult life in an orphanage before finding love with young librarian Clara.

Title: 825. A nagy generáció
description: Things fall apart in Makai's life when his old friend Réb comes back from America with opportunistic intentions.

Title: 826. Salam ya Sahbi
description: Three friends decide to work in watermelon selling, but the head of the vegetables and fruits doesn't like that, so they go on a fight with him.

Title: 828. Mania: House of Cards
description: A young woman is invited for a free stay at a seemly deserted seaside hotel during the off season. Too late she finds out that the manager likes to collect women for his "playing card" collection and she is next in the pack.

Title: 829. Black Mic Mac
description: Michel le Gorgues is a by-the-book government employee in charge of Building Safety & Sanitation at the Paris "Prefecture". Because he has deemed as unsanitary and dangerous a tenement occupied by African immigrants, the zealous official will be a victim of the practices of a great "marabout" or witch doctor, who has been brought from the deep bush in Africa for this occasion. A good-natured comedy on cultural differences, with exceptional performances by Jacques Villeret and Isaach de Bankolé, each with his own brand of comedic timing and style.

Title: 830. Cucoana Chirita
description: The Bârzoi manor comes back to life when the lady of the house, Chirita, sends news that she will be soon coming back from Paris. As the City of Light has changed her views on the world, the family and the help must follow.

Title: 831. Stregati
description: Lorenzo is the conductor of Radio Strega's night show, making up false court sentences for those who suffer from insomnia.

Title: 832. Dream Lovers
description: Without having met, a famous orchestra conductor and a beautiful woman seem destined to be together. They see one another's faces in their dreams, reflected in mirrors, and in crowded streets before finally meeting in person.

Title: 833. The Climb
description: Based on the true story of the 1953 assault on Nanga Parbat, a treacherous Himalayan Peak.

Title: 834. Paradise
description: Viktor and Angelika are a straight couple. He is a professor of veterinary science and she has studied art history. Both are more interested in their hobbies and professions than in each other; also, Viktor isn't terribly interested in satisfying his wife anymore. Their upright relationship changes dramatically when Viktor gets to know Lotte, a former school friend of Angelika's. Back in school, Lotte would have done anything for Angelika.

Title: 835. Locket
description: An emperor leaves his fortune to his grandson instead of his nephew. The nephew pursues them, capturing the emperor's manager but losing the prince. 20 years later, he still holds the manager, seeking lockets with a treasure map.

Title: 836. The Hour of Fear
description: In São Paulo, Alberto is an insane and sadistic man that kills women, and lives with his mother that covers all his mess. When he kills his mother's employee Eliana, stabbing her in the bathtub, they bury her in the backyard of their house. Eliana's fiancé unsuccessfully seeks her out and when Alberto's mother advertises that she needs a driver, he applies for the job to sneak around the real estate trying to find Eliana.

Title: 837. Revenge of the Stolen Stars
description: The ghost of a former mine owner returns to haunt an island in the South China Sea. A clumsy heir searches for legendary rubies while pursued by villains, caught in a web of curse, adventure, and mystery.

Title: 838. Eshelonite
description: World War II. Diverse strata of society # politicians, artists, King Boris III himself # take part in the rescue action to save the resident Jews. Simultaneously, the film features the pains of these people, the horror of the concentration camps, of death. Yet, it is important that the 'Death Echelons' never moved from Bulgaria.

Title: 839. White Rose Campus: After School Incident
description: A beautiful substitute teacher at Shirobara Academy gains popularity with male students but faces hostility from female students and male teachers. The photography club plots to take nude photos of her for an exhibition.

Title: 840. Uuno Turhapuro muuttaa maalle
description: Uuno's father-in-law councillor Tuura moves to the country with his wife and daughter Elisabeth. Uuno joins them when it turns out Tuura's mansion is on the construction site of a new road. Tuura however is set on preventing this.

Title: 841. 40 Quadratmeter Deutschland
description: A Turk has brought a young Turk woman from Turkey to his flat in Germany. The woman does not know much about Germany nor can she speak German.

Title: 842. Puro cashmere
description: Giuliano, kindergarten teacher, goes to his ex's birthday, meets Liliana and falls in love with her.

Title: 843. The Detached Mission
description: Much of the movie's dialogue is in English with Russian dubbed over it.

Title: 845. Time Stranger
description: Time Stranger is the story of a bunch of teenagers getting transported back in time through Japan's history, and getting mixed up with samurai shenanigans.

Title: 846. Ghar Sansar
description: Girdharilal (Kader Khan) is a very rich and wealthy man. He has made a number of enemies. One of his enemies asks a beggar to masquerade as Girdharilal for a price, to which the beggar agrees. The switch takes place, with the real Girdharilal being abducted. A series of hilarious and comical events take turn as the beggar attempts to pretend to be a rich, left-handed tycoon.

Title: 848. Littlefinger
description: Littlefinger (Spriditis) is having a hard time living with the evil stepmother and despite his grandmother's and Lienite's attempts to dissuade him, he goes out into the world to find happiness.

Title: 849. El primer torero porno
description: A teacher, a left-wing militant with a frustrated vocation as a bullfighter, and a feminist are forced to survive by performing in a porn club.

Title: 852. Captive
description: The daughter of an international tycoon is kidnapped by a trio of abductors who seek to mold her to their lifestyle.

Title: 853. Qatl
description: A blind man plans revenge on his adulterous wife.... by murder. A taut thriller that keeps you on the edge of your seat.

Title: 854. Ki lo sa?
description: A group of children from the same neighborhood meet a few years later. When the day comes, they meet again and take stock of their lives.

Title: 855. Tarzan Rifki
description: A naive man in search of a wife is mistaken for a hired killer by the mob. Things get complicated when he falls for the girlfriend of the mob boss.

Title: 858. Amrit
description: Widowed Amrit and Kamala are ill-treated by their respective children and find solace in each other's company. As their bond strengthens, the two decide to separate from their families and spend their lives together.

Title: 860. Black Maria
description: After the death of their sponsor, rock band Zenit falls into a crisis. Thay need to make new arrangments of old songs in only 6 days. There comes to a disagreement between band members because of different opinions.

Title: 861. Asilacak Kadin
description: The life adventure and suicide of a female hero named Melek, who was forced to marry a man with a sick soul and sexual perversions.

Title: 862. Naan Adimai Illai
description: Vijay and Priya fall in love and get married against her father's wishes. However, when they get separated after a fight, Priya's father plots to keep them away from each other.

Title: 863. Batas Impian Ranjang Setan
description: An entire family gets slaughtered at the beginning, except for one young woman who wanders through the house in a daze. We soon see that evil from the past is infecting the present. A Freddy Krueger-like killer stalks people in the present, and kills them in their dreams. We see visions of a zombie floating around as well as the ghost of a white woman as well. A vengeful zombie arises at the end as a good wizard tries to dispense with this curse.

Title: 864. The Beginning
description: After a crash, a group of passengers are stranded in the desert. They attempt to cope with their new conditions as the most privileged of them all, an overpaid lawyer, declares himself a dictator of the nearby oasis and names it after him.

Title: 865. Treasure Island
description: Raúl Ruiz's fabulist modern-day riff on Robert Louis Stevenson's classic novel.

Title: 866. Ninja Destroyer
description: A lucrative emerald mine and the various protagonists who are struggling to wrest control of it for their own profitable ends.

Title: 867. De wisselwachter
description: A woman gets off a train by mistake and finds herself stranded alone with a peculiar man who doesn't even speak her language.

Title: 868. Axiliad
description: A young, idealistic poet turns his back on civilization and goes to a small, backwoods village, rents a bed in the house of an old woman, and decides to make his living as a lumberjack. He soon realizes that the world around him is far from perfect. He does not make any real contact with the people in the village. An then another outcast like him rents a bed in the same house.

Title: 870. Pudhcha Paool
description: The film is based on domestic violence and harassment of women. Exploitation after marriage and how women should take a stand for their own rights. How she's mentally and physically harassed by her husband and greedy mother-in-law.

Title: 871. Bionic Ninja
description: Top agents of the KGB and CIA battle to posses a startling new scientific discovery. In the right hands, the discovery will create an end to famine and war. In the wrong hands, it's misuse will certainly destroy the world. The KGB supported "Ninja Organization" headed by the infamous "Number Zero" gains possession of the secret. CIA agent Tommy must single handedly defeat the Ninja and get the secret microfilm back. It seems a hopeless task, but being as brave as he is, Tommy tries every means.

Title: 873. Fotoromanzo
description: Nino and Anna grow-up as neighbours and song-writing partners. They gradually fall in love, but eventually go there separate ways. Years later, they end up in the same city.

Title: 875. Women Who Do Not Divorce
description: Keiichi falls in love with two women who both happen to be in loveless marriages, but are trapped in meaningless marriages. While being undecided about who he wants to choose, witnesses passions boil to an unforgiving climax.

Title: 876. Ethnic Notions
description: This documentary traces the deep-rooted stereotypes which have fueled anti-black prejudice.

Title: 877. Marauders
description: Two sociopaths who go on a killing spree, are interrupted when a man accidentally runs over one of the psycho's legs, leaving him badly injured.

Title: 878. Scream Greats, Vol. 2: Satanism and Witchcraft
description: Documentary tracks the rise of devil cults, witches and other elements of the "black arts."

Title: 879. Commando Invasion
description: Superb action set during the Vietnam War. The prologue shows a French army convoy being ambushed by the Vietcong in 1950.

Title: 880. Op hoop van zegen
description: Young Barend is worried about the safety of the sailing vessel he is on. The owner is an unscrupulous and stingy man who skimps on repairs and Barend becomes aware of this. Inevitably there is drama and tragedy. The film is set in an early 20th century Dutch fishing village with local period costume and colour.

Title: 881. The Nativity
description: A Mexican film retelling the life of Christ, this is shown annually on Univision.

Title: 882. Shadows on the Wall
description: A reporter becomes the target of a murderer when he starts investigating a fifty-year-old murder/suicide case.

Title: 883. Insaaf Ki Awaaz
description: Inspector Jhansi is an honest police officer. Her brother Ravi falls in love with her rival's daughter. When the girl's father comes to know about his daughter's relationship, he is enraged.

Title: 884. L'aube
description: When the British army occupied Palestine, a young Jewish resident, Elisha, was tasked with carrying out an officer of Her Majesty taken hostage.

Title: 885. Majdanek 1944 - Opfer und Täter
description: This documentary is the film record of one of the first Nazi war crimes trials, which was conducted while the war was still raging. Majdanek, a concentration and extermination camp located near Lublin, Poland, was erected in 1941 and liberated in July 1944. When the Soviet and Polish troops drove the Nazis out of the region, they uncovered the evidence of Nazi genocide. One month later, a joint Soviet-Polish commission heard evidence from survivors and witnesses of the atrocities that took place at Majdanek. Their testimony is preserved in this film. Bengt and Irmgard von zur Muhlen are German film archivists who unearthed a wealth of material in various Eastern bloc archives. Majdanek 1944 includes documentary material made available for the first time in the West.

Title: 886. Stan Rikvin, der letzte der Kopfgeldjäger
887. T.P. Balagopalan M.A.
description: Balagopalan, an educated man, strives to save his earnings for his sister's marriage. He also deals with responsibilities towards his family in a society that is ailing from widespread unemployment.

Title: 888. Jittemai
description: After their executions are faked by the authorities, three criminals are forced to become assassins under the Shogun's command

Title: 889. Zone rouge
description: Claire Rousset visits her ex-husband Pierre who lives in the Lyon region. For some time now, Pierre's health and that of the other inhabitants of the village has deteriorated to the point of becoming worrying.

Title: 890. Toda la vida
description: Three friends, two married and one single, are determined to have a good time. But their wives are not far behind and give the husbands a well-deserved surprise.

Title: 891. Getting Even
description: A soldier-of-fortune steals some Russian nerve gas from Afghanistan, and brings it to the U.S. to be analyzed. A greedy millionaire rancher finds out about it and sets out to steal it.

Title: 892. The Great Wall Is a Great Wall
description: A gentle investigation of the clash of cultures when a Chinese-American family from San Francisco descends on their relatives in Peking. In HD.

Title: 893. Bleu comme l'enfer
description: Ned, a small-time criminal on the run and a policeman's wife escape together, hunted by the obsessed cop in a tense, dangerous thriller.

Title: 894. Aap Ke Saath
description: Two brothers, Ashok and Vimal, face romantic troubles. After Ganga falsely accuses Ashok of assault, he pays her off. Their grandfather bring Deepa as Ashok's match, but she likes Vimal. Ashok later discovers Ganga working as a courtesan.

Title: 895. A Quiet Death
description: A writer abandons her life and husband and wanders the streets of a deserted city in search of herself.

Title: 896. High School
description: Ali Nasseri, a biology teacher who has recently quit his addiction, goes back to his birthplace in the Province of Mazandaran after three years. Because of his father's good background he is returned to his teaching job. He takes a personal interest in the problems of a troubled student.

Title: 897. Sauve-toi, Lola
description: Hospitalized, surrounded by other women, a 35-year-old lawyer with breast cancer tries to survive and redefine her life.

Title: 898. Nighty Night: Midnight Nightmares
description: "Nighty Night: Mayonaka No Akuma" ("Nighty Night: Midnight Nightmares") is a non-hosted horror anthology movie from Japan; released in 1986.

Title: 899. Rajavinte Makan
description: The film follows underworld don Vincent Gomas (Mohanlal) and his rivalry against the Kerala Home minister N. Krishnadas (Ratheesh).

Title: 900. Il Bi e il Ba
description: A man goes to Rome because he wants a magician to solve his problem: dandruff.

Title: 901. Asli Naqli
description: Seth Laxmi Narayan and his wife had a son who was separated at an early age. The only clue they have is that he has a locket around his neck. When Laxmi Narayan passes away, he leaves behind a lot of money and wealth. His wife makes efforts to locate her long-lost son, with the help of her relative, Durjan Singh. Durjan Singh hires a local thug, Birju, and asks him to pose as the long-lost son, for a hefty price, to which he agrees. Mrs. Narayan welcomes Birju as her son, and accepts him, little knowing his agenda, and the evil scheme devised by Durjan Singh and his son.

Title: 902. Ozone: The Attack of the Redneck Mutants
description: When a toxic chemical spill tears open the ozone above rural Texas, locals mutate into ghouls with an appetite for flesh. Dubbed dialogue, surreal padding, Americana weirdness, and inventive practical gore make Ozone unforgettable.

Title: 903. Gandhinagar 2nd Street
description: Sethu is an unemployed youth, struggling to get a job. However, when a spate of robberies take place in the neighborhood, his friend poses him as a Nepali to get a job as a security guard.

Title: 904. Sadaa Suhagan
description: Lakshmi and Rajshekar marry, each carrying past trauma. She had a cruel stepmother; he grew up poor. After a near-death experience deepens their bond, they build a successful life. Their well-raised children rebel as adults.

Title: 905. Ang walang malay
description: The unsuspecting attracts the corrupt.

Title: 906. Stammheim - The Baader-Meinhof Gang on Trial
description: Stammheim Prison in Stuttgart, West Germany. Five defendants are charged with the murder of four U.S. servicemen in a terrorist attack.

Title: 907. In de schaduw van de overwinning
description: During WWII, two members of the Dutch resistance share the same goal but use very different methods to reach it.

Title: 908. Halimaw
description: A drama director tries his hand at the horror-suspense genre with this twin-story omnibus film; the other film is Christopher De Leon's debut film.

Title: 909. Kiri
description: Deserving or not, a sweet and innocent-looking lass earns a reputation reserved for the hot-blooded female.

Title: 911. Busted Up
description: The owner of an inner-city gym happens to also be a skilled fighter, and when he is pressured by real-estate developers to close the gym, he fights in order to save it.

In 1938, Austria is about to become a part of the Third Reich. A theater actress and a Jewish journalist fall in love and spend time together, completely ignoring the political turmoil of the time despite friendly warnings.

Title: 913. The Sidewalks of Saturn
description: Fabian, a Latin American musician in Paris, reappears after a mysterious absence, claims visions of a dead musician, and becomes determined to return to his troubled homeland

Title: 915. 1/2 Mensch
description: A visual documentary captures Einstürzende Neubauten's 1985 Japan tour, featuring their striking performance in a doomed ironworks ruin, blending choreographed industrial spectacle with raw live footage.

Title: 916. Saveray Wali Gaadi
description: Ravidas (Sunny Deol) lives in a village in rural India. He is the son of Chediram (Dr. Shreeram Lagoo) who is of highly respected in the village. Ravidas falls in love with Jyoti (Poonam Dhillon). Their love becomes known in the village. Because of differences of caste, the villagers are opposed to Ravidas marrying Jyoti. Chediram commits suicide due to the shame his son has brought upon him. Ravidas is a gifted poet, but he cannot fulfill his dream of being recognized as a great poet, his poems being published and shown to the world, because he lives in a village. So he decides to go to the city to fulfill his dreams and to eventually marry Jyoti. In the city he recovers the purse of a young lady from a thief. The young lady turns out to be the daughter of a big newspaper publisher. The newspaper publisher hears of Ravidas's talent for poetry through his daughter. He publishes some of Ravidas's poems in a column in his newspaper. Ravidas starts becoming famous and his dream is fulfilled. He communicates to Jyoti by writing on the side of the morning express train, hence the title of the film Saveray Wali Gaadi. Jyoti reads these message each morning hoping for the time when Ravidas will return and take her away with him.

Title: 917. Banter
description: An alcoholic partier becomes a paranoid maniac when a manuscript that predicts real-life horrors takes possession of his mind.

Title: 918. Commando Fury
description: Women prisoners are tortured, whipped, beaten and humiliated inside a WWII detention camp. The commander of the camp (Shou-Ping Tsui) and his aides (Yvonne Wang and Celia Kong) interrogate the prisoners looking for some important microfilm. Meanwhile, some of the prisoners hatch a plan to escape the camp.Even the trees attack the prisoners at one point.

Title: 919. Makaroni Blues
description: When Italian Vincenzo comes to Norway to open a restaurant, Norwegian drinking habits and alcohol politics are seen with southern European eyes. Vincenzo dies trying, and his brother seeks revenge.

Title: 920. Duty
description: An honest police officer comes in bad books of corrupt businessman Seth Dharamraj.

Title: 921. Y... se hizo justicia
description: A man is searching for a gang that raped and murdered his wife and daughter, he's ready for revenge.

Title: 923. Super Fantozzi
description: Fantozzi, an unlucky character, traces his ill-fated lineage from being expelled from Eden through various humiliating adventures across time periods until reaching the future Space Age.

Title: 924. Comic Magazine
description: Kinameri is a moderately successful television journalist itching for a big scoop. So when a corrupt local businessman barricades himself in his house, of course he's going to be excited with things picking up.

Title: 925. Main Balwaan
description: Over the years underworld criminal don Rai Bahadur has acquire a fortune full of priceless jewelery from around the world by pressuring his only son Anil to rob them bit by bit. His activities crease when Anil inform him that he wants to put a halt on criminal activities as he would like to get marry to a woman named Geeta; not pleased with this Rai Bahadur turn Anil out of his house. Geeta and Anil then get married in a near-by temple but unfortunately when they go to her home, Geeta's police inspector brother, Chowdhury turn them out of the house as he had planned her marriage elsewhere. The couple then take up lodging in a rented flat; eventually time passes with Geeta getting pregnant with Anil's child; when her health worsen Anil is forced to return to robbing jewels for his father where-by he is shot by Inspector Chowdhury. Before passing away Anil inform Geeta that his dad was responsible for his death - Geeta then give birth to a baby boy, leave him in the care of her brother Inspector Chowdhury and goes to Rai Bahadur house with a loaded revolver never to hear from again. Meanwhile the baby boy is raised by Inspector Chowdhury and years later is known as Tony; Tony is willing to work with the police to capture Rai Bahadur who is now known as Hira. Eventually he gets to meet Hira who poison his mind to the extent of revolting against the police and the very man who raised him, Inspector Chowdhury.

Title: 926. The Last Emperor
description: The story of Aisin-Gioro Puyi, the last emperor of Qing dynasty, focusing on the later half of his life.

Title: 927. Pasos Largos: El último bandido andaluz
description: "Pasos largos" (long steps) is an alias for the last Andalusian bandit, after engaging in poaching for a living, he begins to commit small crimes in the mountainous area of Ronda (Malaga, Spain), but everything gets even more complicated.

Title: 928. Dheem Tharikida Thom
description: The movie narrates the day-to-day funny incidents happening and a romance blooming in the background of a ballet troupe.

Title: 930. Dot and Keeto
description: The fantastic adventures of little redheaded Dot in the Australian bush.

Title: 931. The Cosmic Eye
description: Earth is visited by a race of aliens, who issue an ultimatum: either peace or complete destruction.

Title: 932. Just Married
description: After marrying her 19 year old boyfriend at the oppossition of her mother, 17 year old Randy and her new husband go to a wacky hotel where the staff are secretly betting on the couples breaking up before they leave. The staff do their vest but love wins out in the end.

Title: 933. Happy New Year
description: The story of two brothers of different orientation and fate. The drama takes place in an atmosphere of tension and fear, during the conflict of Yugoslav Communist Party with the Stalinism, during the Cominform. Older brother Dragoslav, a returnee from Russia, was unjustly accused of being a Russian spy and subsequently arrested. Younger brother Kosta is not interested in politics, but he's attracted by a brother's wife Vera and underworld mafia. In the end, it turns out that a young woman belongs to the Soviet spy agency.

Title: 934. Prazdnik Neptuna
description: A group of Swedish tourists are on the way to a Russian village to witness the so called 'Festivity of Neptunus', in which the inhabitants take a dive in a hole in the ice. This tradition, however, does not exist at all. The inhabitants try to make a good impression by starting the 'tradition' to please the tourists.

Title: 935. Hostage
description: The leader of a South African Nation is imprisoned. His followers, led by Zabo, hijack a plane with the intent to use the passengers as hostages to trade for his release. They select a plane carrying a religious leader to use as their main hostage. They soon learn that they have an added bonus of the daughter and grandson of Colonel Shaw, a bigwig in the country. The grandson all the while has to cope with the dual problems of being hijacked and held hostage while needing a kidney transplant. The hijackers have everything in their favor, except that the colonel's daughter is the sweetheart of Major Sam Striker. Striker puts together a band of mercenaries and sets about freeing the hostages.

Title: 936. Le complexe du kangourou
description: The story of a man who wants to be a father.

Title: 937. Yesterday, Today and Tomorrow
description: An assertive young stepmother, a rebellious stepdaughter, and a working wife whose career provides tension between the wife and husband are the portraits of the strong-willed woman of the 1980s.

Title: 939. Ennennum Kannettante
description: A young man comes to his ancestral home in a village for a family re-union and temple festivities during his college vacation days. Then arrives his childhood friend after a gap of 9 years and his priorities suddenly change.

Title: 940. Tabarana Kathe
description: Tabarana Kathe is the story of Tabara Shetty, a government servant. He serves the government till his retirement. But problems emerge after his retirement. Matters worsen when his wife and only companion falls sick.

Title: 941. Der Bärenhäuter
description: East German fairy tale adaption of the Brothers Grimm story "Bearskin" in which a soldier is tasked by the devil to not wash himself for seven years. In return, the soldier receives a pocket that never runs out of money.

Title: 942. Mientras México duerme
description: El manto oscuro de la noche con el que los maleantes se cubren para efectuar sus fechorías. Un retrato de la delincuencia urbana en México, hilando una historia de crimen y drama.

Title: 944. Ryder P.I.
description: When there's trouble, he'll be there. When there's a disaster, he's been there.

Title: 945. Samay Ki Dhaara
description: Ambitious Delhi-based Design Engineer Ajay Verma weds traditional and conservative Madhvi, both live a middle-class lifestyle, until Ajay opens a business under his wife's name. Then both have differences, grow apart despite of giving birth to a son, Aroop, so much so that they decide to separate. When Madhvi finds out that Ajay is having a relationship with Rashmi, she decides to wed widower, Dr. Vinod Kapoor, and moves in with him and his two children, Pappu and Pinky, in Krishnanagar. It is here that she will find that Aroop has become a problem child and may have to decide sending him to live with Ajay and Rashmi.

Title: 946. Laputa
description: Malgorzata and Paul have a rendezvous in West Berlin to spend some time together before she has to go back to Warsaw and he returns to his wife and daughter. The two talk, disagree, argue, make-up, quarrel and talk some more.

Title: 947. Bar 51
description: After the mother's death, the siblings leave the family home and go to Tel Aviv. They both intend to start a new life. They meet the transgender Apolonia, the owner of Bar 51, who offers them help and work.

Title: 948. Ayrilamam
description: The enemy of Emrah and his family, who are trying to survive after losing their father, is the closest.

Title: 949. Chaalbaaz
description: A business tycoon's daughter is kidnapped by a terrorist and held for a ransom. But what the terrorist doesn't know is that they picked the wrong man to mess with.

Title: 950. Bhabhi Dian Choorian
description: After their love marriage Aslam and Aminah are living happily in a village. After some years his younger step brother arrives to live with them and than Aslam dislikes this change of situation and reacts badly.

Title: 951. Baat Ban Jaye
description: Mr. Singh lives a wealthy lifestyle in a mansion named 'Ashiana' on 10th Road, Juhu, Bombay, with his only relative, a niece by the name of Nisha, who is unmarried and runs the family's business that faces strong opposition from Khanna Group of Industries. Singh would like to see her get married but she hates wealthy men. So her uncle finds a poor man, Ajay Srivastav, but subsequently finds out that Ajay is already married and also has 3 daughters; then he decides to get Nisha married to a TV repairman, Yeshwant Bhosle, who ends up being a multi-millionaire after his invention is marketed; then he wants her to get married to Viju Guide, a Hyderabad-based Tourist Guide, who finds buried treasure and also ends up a multi-millionaire; then he wants her to get married to a motor mechanic, Prakash, who, in turn, ends up being the only son of wealthy builder, Jayant Amar Nath, and ends up getting married to his sweetheart and neighbor, Rosy. Finally Nisha meets her ideal match in Rukhtapur-based Suraj Singh, a wedding singer/dancer, and gets married to him - not realizing that Suraj is not who he claims to be and she is merely a pawn in a charade that has been created especially to pull wool over her eyes.

Title: 952. Brigada explosiva
description: The Z Brigade comes into action after the robbery to a bank and unwittingly ends up helping the thieves to carry out the robbery, which causes them to be sent back to the police school by their superiors.

Title: 953. On Wings of Fire
description: Maestro Zubin Mehta introduces the history of Zoroastrianism and prophet Zarathushtra in an epic that covers three thousand five hundred years of the Zoroastrians, Parsees of India.

Title: 954. O Dynasteias
description: The adventurous life of a man who wandered around the world, spent a few years playing "Tarzan" in the jungle, became rich and eventually returned back in his birth-place.

Title: 955. Matatalim na Pangil sa Gubat
description: A monster believed by the old folks to be possessed by Satan himself wreaks havoc on a small coastal town.

Title: 956. Pohlad kocce usi
description: The girls' choir of the Ostrava House of Culture prepares for a competition. After realizing the competition is two months away, the girls began rehearsing in various places.

Title: 957. Magkayakap sa magdamag
description: Three young woman use their bodies in their search for the elusive true love.

Title: 958. Yue Yue
description: Yue Yue is a village girl living in the Qin Ling Mountain. Two boys, Cai Cai and Men Men, are her friends and both like her. Cai Cai is diligent and conservative, Men Men is discontented with life and like novelty.

Title: 959. Sana'y wala nang wakas
description: Is there a price for stardom? Does it cost a treasured friendship? A beautiful romance? A loving father? Success tests the friendship of three friends who succeed as a singing trio until one of them becomes a soloist.

Title: 960. Evil in the Woods
description: A boy borrows Evil in the Woods from the library and starts reading at home. He becomes dangerously absorbed in the story set in Mildew, Georgia. Will he finish the tale or be trapped in its pages forever?

Title: 961. Nandi Veendum Varika
description: Mohandas, a police officer is often ridiculed for his cowardly nature. However, circumstances lead him to overcome his behavior and become a successful officer.

Title: 962. A King and His Movie
description: Buenos Aires movie director, very fond of legend of King of Patagonia and Araucania, decides to make a movie about it.

Title: 963. Razvod na odredjeno vreme
description: Sinisa and Svetlana embark on a honeymoon to Spain, but they end up on the banks of the Montenegrin coast due to travel agency's mistake. Upon their return to Belgrade, Svetlana submits a request for an apartment, but the new problem is the fact that divorced mothers with children have an advantage. They decide to divorced part-time in order to deceive the housing commission and get an apartment.

Title: 964. La femme de ma vie
description: A renowned violinist's descent into alcoholism costs him his marriage and career. After a fateful encounter, a kindred spirit guides his path to sobriety and redemption.

Title: 965. Hollywood Dreaming
description: Alec has a great script, but no money. The fun begins as he tries to squeeze cash out of a nymphomaniac widow, a sexy young heiress, two well-heeled duck hunters, and a desperately daring debutante.

Title: 966. Lost Romance
description: Rose is living an idyllic life with her brother. They are so close that their bond has a subtle hint of incest. The bond is broken when her brother dies until she meets a guy who looks like her deceased brother.

Title: 967. Keeping Track
description: The CIA, KGB and RCMP are after an honest lady banker and her crusading journalist friend after the two come into the possession of a superchip that could start WWIII, if it walls into the wrong hands.

Title: 969. Mr. Love
description: A mild-mannered gardener becomes a lovable legend in his town for his talent to romantically please every woman that fancies him.

Title: 970. Hollywood Ghost Stories
description: An investigation into the reports of houses in Hollywood that are supposedly haunted by the ghosts of dead movie stars.

Title: 971. Falfúró
description: Budapest, in the 1980's. Géza and his family living in the block flat microdistrict. One morning Géza meets a young lady in the elevator. This moment change his life. On the same day he quits his factory job and decides to start his own business: became a wall driller, as there a big demand for it in the neighborhood.

Title: 972. Pretty Women Walking Through the City
description: Belgrade in 2041 is a deserted city that looks like a dump yard. A few old men try to bring up a group of young girls in the old, traditional way of their Yugoslav ancestors.

Title: 973. The Young Taoism Fighter
description: A mischievous martial arts disciple constantly breaks the rules, including helping a female martial artist defeat an evil rival kung fu master.

Title: 974. Stella on Holiday
description: When her husband breaks his arm, Stella is forced to go in his place with his Swedish colleague on a fishing trip. Unbeknownst to her, she picks up the wrong man on the airport; a man coming to Iceland to attend a rehab facility. She, along with her children, go to a cabin with the strange man, where comedy ensues.

Title: 975. Cidade Oculta
description: Romantic bandits, corrupt policemen, a mysterious woman, escapes, chases, shootings, all set in São Paulo by night.

Title: 976. Ek Main Aur Ek Tu
description: A successful businessman's return to his hometown reignites old tensions, as his son and his former boss's daughter find themselves drawn together despite family conflicts.

Title: 977. Magdusa ka!
description: An embittered mother sends her daughter away when the girl reestablishes a relationship with her estranged father.

Title: 978. City of Mice
description: Probably the most famous puppet show for children and all ages. Mice who have to leave their school and immigrate because of a wild cat who wants to eat them up. Eventually the mice defeat the cat and go back to their home.

Title: 979. Blood Hunt
description: A new doctor arrives at a small town, where he slowly discovers their deadly secret of annually kidnapping, imprisoning, and hunting drug addicts. When he tries to interfere, he becomes the next target.

Title: 980. Amor a la vuelta de la esquina
description: Maria escapes from prison. On the run, she breaks her ankle. Julian, a truck driver, finds her sitting at the roadside, crying. He picks her up and takes her to a hospital. On her first chance, Maria flees again and goes to a hotel, where she ends up as a prostitute. She frequents bars and saloons, commits some robberies, but neither sex, nor the tequila, can replace love.

Title: 981. Kamagong
description: Arnis, the ancient Filipino martial art, took center stage in this coming of age drama wherein a young boy perfected his skills and his idol rediscovered what it takes to be a man.

Title: 982. Forgotten Warrior
description: Steve Parrish (Ronald Marchini) is fighting in Vietnam in 1974. He is injured and after a six-month recovery in a small village, he decides to stay behind and marry a local woman. He teaches the whole village martial arts including a small boy who resembles Scott Baio and has the fan favorite bowl haircut.

Title: 983. Los amores de Laurita
description: Laurita, a 40-year-old woman, accepts taboos of all kinds. In the search for an identity, she goes from one man to another, from the present to the past, from fantasy to reality. However, there is a tension that grows and grows, until it culminates in a surprise. Her memory goes back to review her loves and the different stages of her life: adolescence, her transgressing role and her fight against her own prejudices.

Title: 984. You Must Be Joking!
description: A series of practical jokes narrated by David Blood and Tony Sanderson.

Title: 985. Defenders of the Earth: The Story Begins
description: True to its title, "The Story Begins" introduces the audience to the Defenders of the Earth's colorfully animated cast of characters.

Title: 987. Kanne Kaniyamudhe
description: Kanan's mother leaves the house as she is fed up of his father's violent behavior. However, years later, when he opens a dance institute, Kanan's mother requests him for a job as she is unaware of his identity.

Title: 988. Ratha Sapthami
description: An aspiring singer from a poor household falls in love with a girl from an affluent family. However, her father disapproves of their relationship.

Title: 989. The Mines of Kilimanjaro
description: An American college student in 1930s Africa searches for a lost diamond mine near Mt. Kilimanjaro. He must battle Germans who are using the mine to finance their war plans, as well as Chinese gangsters and murderous local tribesmen.

Title: 990. Miljardi vuotta ennen maailmanloppua
description: An astrophysicist on vacation secretly continues to work on his thesis, "The Interaction of Stars with Diffused Galactic Matter". When realize that he is on the verge of a great discovery his life becomes plagued by strange events.

Title: 991. 7 chili in 7 giorni
description: Two not-too-clever young doctors open a fitness center and promise that people can lose 7 kilos in 7 days; when the enterprise fails, they open a gourmet restaurant.

Title: 992. Maison Ikkoku - Apartment Fantasy
description: Travel into Japan's nuttiest apartment house and meet its volatile inhabitants.

Title: 993. Lost in the Wilderness
description: Adventure-drama based on the life of Naomi Uemura (Nishida), the first Japanese mountain climber to scale most of the world's highest peaks and explore the arctic and Antarctic.

Title: 994. I nyhta me ti Silena
description: With the vivid remembrance of a mysterious brunette still etched on his mind, her lonely secret admirer has a chance encounter with a dead ringer for her and attempts to appease his repressed emotions.

Title: 995. Képvadászok
description: A comedy inspired by the real-life robbery of the Museum of Fine Arts in Budapest in 1983, in which the thieves lose a suitcase filled with their loot.

Title: 998. Gilsodom
description: A historical drama that incorporates real footage from the 1983 KBS campaign to reunite families divided by the Korean War with the fictional story of Hwa-yeong, a woman who leaves her middle-class life in Busan to search for the son she lost in Gilsotteum during the war.

Title: 999. Touch: Ace Without a Number on His Back
description: A compilation film of the first year of the 'Touch' series. It has plot differences, newly added scenes and an alternate ending.

Title: 1000. Chido Guan, el tacos de oro
